Look, we are perfectly capable of dealing with any rodent infestation on THIS planet, but if someone is teleporting rats in from Universe 432718 or god-knows-where, that is another matter entirely.

If anyone has further information on where these rats are coming from, PLEASE LET US KNOW. Thanks, and best of luck with your science.

- Stanley Rein, Janitorial Supervisor

P.S. We caught one of the little fellas, if anyone needs it back.
Isaiah, I'm looking at Elanor's specs for the T3. We need to extend the subwavelength limit of the lens, which takes a lot of silver for surfacing - have you still got a stockpile?
Fresh out. But here's the thing. There's an almost infinite amount of silver in IS-0138. That's where I've been getting it.
Wait, you've been raiding the Train for silver? Are you insane?
What's the problem? It grows back.

TO: DEFENSE TEAM

Ensure LARGE SURFACE ELEVATOR is clear in advance of Executive Committee arrival tomorrow morning.

No Defense Team activity in the area between 11:00am-12:00pm.

All urgent transit between those times should take place via TR facilities.
Daria, do you have any data on IS-0407? Derek is obsessed with 0064, but I can't find anything AT ALL on this other one.
We've got almost nothing on 407. There's your Flathill report, and that's it. Are you even sure it's a different entity? Could it just have been injured?
Injured, intact. How can you tell with these things? But I know what I saw, and it wasn't 64. It looked like someone smashed a doll.
Divinitor, I salute your planning with this fact: we have secured the facility's Reservoir and Power Plant. We await your assent to move on to the Reactor. How progresses our bretheren in Voussoir?
They report success, and will soon have access to the Snowbeast's domain. Once this is secured, they intend to use the prometheans' portals to make contact with your force. You will be informed.
Bonum erit.

Hi Denis,

Have you been able to take any samples of IS-0202 yet?

Bonjour Daria.

Apologies, we have not. The presence of IS-0134 has made any research into the skeletal remains extremely challenging. It appears to guard, even protect the remains. As to why it might do this, we are uncertain. I will alert you as soon as the situation changes.

Hi Bridget

Sorry I don't have a lot to give you. Read the full report for yourself, but the key data is:

- We have not been able to open a stable perforation to Anteverse 39; we've had to rely on those 'created' by IS-0059.

- There were no reported manifestations of either IS-0059 or portals to A39 before our first onsite perforation experiments; Dr Shepherd's analysis indicates incidences are increasing.

- Following one such appearance, we dispatched a squad of Gatekeepers through a residual perforation under urgency. We have had no subsequent communications from that squad.

- In at least one instance, two staff exposed to the same A39 portal reported seeing entirely different details on the far side, suggesting perceptive subjectivity may be an element here.

- There are indications IS-0059 is susceptible to high energy x-rays; Dr. Tengku is investigating.
We've seen this thing nearly half a dozen times, it just APPEARS in the facility at leisure now, and that's all we know?! Dr. Hammond seems to have a much better handle on the situation than you do.

I strongly contest Dr. Hammond's thesis and methods. He is unrigorous and I only included a summary of his notes out of respect for his work on IS-0010, etc. Drawing conclusions based on little more than mythology is unreliable in the extreme.

I would further emphasize that calling A39 a 'purgatory' or the 'latest instance of a recurrent yet chimeric underworld' is entirely without concrete evidence.

As to A39 being a 'psycho-nest' built by IS-0059 using living material 'harvested' from external regions, the man is letting his imagination run away with him.
this erupted has         contagion               entire     blackness engulf
intrusion     endless and unholy           reviled for                       night
consumes       ourselves

Frake has signed off the monitoring station, and it's live. It should give steady results from the Neutrino Detector to anyone who can be bothered to walk up to the Waterfall Apartments.

It can only update once an hour, so if you want realtime data, you'll still have to sail out to the tower.
Thanks Greyson. If there's any issues, I'll shout. But this look great.
Rutger, I was at the Security range on Tuesday, and I couldn't help noticing something that the targets on the gun range all have labcoats. Why is that, exactly?
This falls into the 'I'll do my job, you do yours' category, Richard.

Hey Steven,

Quick question. I was in the Dam doing some work with 0142 this week, and I noticed something.

Have the glowworms been moving? I swear they've all moved since I was here last. Have you noticed anything?
About the glowworms? No, Daria, they're worms. They glow. That's what I notice.
It looks like they've bunched up. I'm almost sure of it. I wish I'd taken some pictures to compare.
Focus on 0142, Daria. They're just glow worms. Watch your head.

Hey, it's me again.

This is getting a little weird... My friend from ASO just sent me this data on the down-low. You might recall they've got that VLA just over the range from Voussoir. 

They've picked up some pretty remarkable signals recently, and some uncomfortable ones at that. We both thought it was a planet, initially.

Please check over this data and see if I've missed anything. I'm hoping I'm just being a bit paranoid. These mountains will do that to you.
This is quite peculiar. I don't think you're being paranoid, no. Did you meet up with this "friend"?

I tried... Haven't heard back for a couple weeks, but I don't want to just sit on this kind of data. It feels irresponsible to keep it to myself at this point. I'll let you know if I hear anything else.

Marta

We need this sample assessed URGENTLY. 

IS-0059 appeared while we were testing Varsha's x-ray system, and it accidentally strayed into the beam. It dropped this material I've sent to your lab.

It seems to be emitting blackbody radiation, but I need more data. Please be extremely careful.
This is incredible. Thank you, Suan. I'll get back to you as as soon as I can.

Kath

I've been looking at this plant from the Reservoir, the Dimweed. The most remarkable thing about it is that it seems to grow at such low light levels, though I suppose we shouldn't discount the illumination from IS-0142.
Interesting. But it's called Murkweed, because the water's so murky.
I'd say it's more 'dim', so Dimweed. And testing suggests it's actually edible.
After you, Idris.
Take a squad of your fratres and seek alta terra. Arrange yourselves for undique coverage, but we do not expect sustained threats from the water. You have full authority to free souls.
Bonum, Legate. We are positioned. The apostates and their demons will be given unto judgement.
Hey Katherine, Idris - where did you say you collected that Murkweed?
Excuse me, it's Dimweed.
Take it up with Katherine, she said she calls it Murkweed, and you know... she's our lead botanist, so...

It's dimly lit. You can barely see it down there in the water.

It's dim. It's a weed.

Dimweed.
As far as I'm concerned, you're both dimweeds.

Praetor, it seems the prometheans have unwittingly revealed the location of a Lodestone. They established a Rift with no inkling of what they have unearthed.

The Rift is in their Particle Lab, near their bestiary, but we have not been able to reopen it. The adjoinment seems to require a biological activation. Inquisitors investigating suggest that GATE have harnessed growths from the dimension of sleep. The Reaper's excretions and coiled vines carry a worldbridge within them. We can utilize these to restore the rift.

Inquisitor Malanaki disinterred data indicating that GATE dispatched an expedition to the Lodestone's location. He interprets their psychobabble to imply they have encountered a sect of soi disant Bogomils, who worship the artefact.

If this is so, it is only be a matter of time until these meddlers discover the Lodestone, and thence its origin. I submit, this would be disastrous.

Please advise your desired course.

Divinitor, tu bene.

We are aware of this sect. Their creed flows from the same font, but riven from all sense or proportion. Directionless, their patriarch is devout, all perceivable virtues of a humble saint, but his theodicy is indistinguishable from mania.

However, take comfort. GATE's discovery is perhaps to our advantage. We must also observe penitence: they located what we had lost.

Let them retrieve the Lodestone, then relieve them of that burden before they determine its provenance. Their investigations into such an object would be akin to flashing a beacon to the cosmos. We cannot allow them to examine it closely.

It cannot be permitted.

I regret to report that Inquisitor Sydyk has failed to return from his foray through the Rift to the suspected Lodestone XVII site.

We believe he has joined the perierunt. Nos recordabor.

As I comprehend it, our ignorance is threefold: our bretheren's fate, the fate of Lodestone XVII, and how to reactivate the Rift.

This is deeply troubling, and in the final account, unacceptable. Resolve this or it will be the annulled you join, not the perierunt.

Abe, I received a pretty solid download from the TR foray to A10 today. They were scanning level K45b9.1. Most of it's gibberish, as you'd expect, but I was getting pretty frustrated, so I started a more stochastic search.

Guess what I found? Do the words 'soft Lyco-ordinates' mean anything to you! I couldn't believe it, but I'm interested in your thoughts. I'm sure there's more here if we can formulate the right inquiries. Come check it out when you get a moment.

Well, that's very interesting, Theo. Very interesting indeed. I'm a little tied up with a packet of Anteverse 2 data that seems to have spooked Derek, but I should be able to come and review your findings tomorrow, if I can just figure out what this carrier signal is hiding.

Greyson, an urgent request: please install Level 5 security on the IS-0083 immurement site immediately. 

It has come to my attention that the entity is more fragile - and potentially prone to contamination - than we believed. Furthermore, it looks like staff have been interacting with 0083 on their personal time, which we can no longer permit due to the elevated risks. If Strauss or Enderson ask any questions, direct them to me.
Copy, will get someone on that shortly.
This is done now, see attached.

Ajay, I thought you should be the first to hear about this. Marta and I have finally managed to stabilize the alloy.

We doped the samples with the material Rigg's recovered from A2 and it extended the half life tenfold. Saying this stuff is 'strange' is a bit like calling the sun 'hot'.

That's incredible, Zahi. Please continue to monitor. I don't want to announce just yet. It's an amazing energy source, but there's still some questions upstairs about using the bodily fluids of randomly mutated bio-specimens as a nuclear catalyst. You know how they can be.

Emails.Subject: Who thought this was a good idea?

Sections.Text:
I know it's not going to change anything, but I'm tired of our sector being used as a holding pen for whatever Gatekeepers dragged from God-knows-where. As if keeping it down here makes it 'safe'?

And now these bots! What happened to them? You let Gatekeepers take those units on a few missions, and they come back looking like they've been reprogrammed by gremlins!
If you're not interested, ignore them. They're proving highly useful to the Gatekeepers, and we're looking into the specifics of their adjustments as I type this.

I should have guess you were involved, Stewart. I know you'll say it's 'all science', but you're exposing these robots to operative forces we don't fully grasp - hell, you don't even KNOW what the hell happened.

And don't even get me started on you-know-who. I still don't know what to think about those upgrade designs for her that you showed me in your Residence quarters last week.
I have Ms. Muir's complete consent in all of this. You know that.
Hey Jan, do you remember asking me where I thought the GKs came from, where they found them?
Yeah, vaguely - I always assumed they had some secret cabbage patch at Intrados.

Well, I was in a gear design meeting for the Gatekeepers with some Synaptics folk and Ives was in the call, too. He mentioned that they recruited 'technicals' out of West Africa, but also something about a place near Sinclair, Wyoming.
Is that it, Lionel?
Yeah, the GKs don't exactly hand out recruitment brochures.

Praetor, the Inquisitors have presented me with an urgent appeal.

They believe the Gatekeepers are too formidible a foe to address unaided. Our losses are high. They beseech the use of interdictum armis.

H.I. Hasta Tria specifically believes we have the tools within the Praetorium to turn the tide of battle, if only we are permitted to employ them.

We anticipated losses. 

Sapentia dictat that we hold in reserve these artefacts, which by their very existence threaten our world.

There is precedent for their use in extremis, but not due to the overweaned ambitions of Inquisitors. They have an agenda of their own, as you are well aware.
Pareo. I personally request, then, that you dispatch a turma of Interfectors to assist us.

I must decline, Legate. This is the same request by a different name.

The Interfectors are a last resort, and we do not stand at that precipice. Their sisterhood would raze this facility to the earth with us inside as punishment for our failings. The mere mention indicates to me you are slipping in the execution of your duties.

I trust this is not the case.

Praetor, I must report troubling activities among the Inquisitors.

It appears they are taking excessive liberties with the knowledge afforded them by their access to GATE's equipment. Quidem, I believe they possess a dangerous sympathy with the workings and dire purpose of this facility.

Only this morning, I discovered they have been utilizing the promethean's rift transport without authorization. They claim to be pursuing the maior finis of our order, but I have formidable doubts.

I fathom your fears, Legate.

The Inquisitors must, by their very nature, pursue their tasks at the limit of acceptable investigation. But you are also trusted to determine where this line sits at any given time. They are precious resources, but not, in the final estimation, indispensible. If you must make an example, do so.

Durum est proelium.

It is a stygian wasteland, yet they defend it like demons.
When you triumph, all the greater will be your return to Nabataea.

Praetor, a full report will be composed in due course, but our Inquisitors determined the following from their investigation of the entity that has colonized the sub-aquatic zone of the facility's Hydroplant Sector:

- It is mechanoid with biological characteristics.
- The precise purpose of its growth is unclear, but it appears to be sending tendrils into the strata beneath the cavern.
- There is nothing beneath the reservoir, although High Inq. Hasta Tria surmises they are reaching for the planetary core, or beyond it. He believes an investigation of the antipodal Atlantic is in order. This does not concern us at this time, I merely convey his prattles.
- Extrarius: Clericus Soter observes that A-3200 is likely to impact near this location in 2110. I was unable to press him further as he was obcido shortly thereafter, requiescatus.

Derek,

I would send this to no-one but you, and I trust it goes no further until I have evidence for this statement: I believe we are being observed here. 

Above and beyond these increasingly fascinating creatures and their undeniable culture, I have ... a sense. I know you mistrust such vagueness, and I understand why, but I feel that there is something else here, an intrusion, as if my mind were being scrutinized by something distant and indistinct. 

Suffice to say, I will continue my research and return soon enough.

ALL TRANSRECON STAFF:

How did the Crown Control corn processing room get blocked by this fungal bloom?

People are NOT following decon procedures, so now we've got to send another team into A2C to retrieve that antifungal agent just to OPEN a door! We discussed this EXTENSIVELY following the FIRST foray into A2C.

I will be conducting a full review of access to the Flathill facility and I WILL be getting to the bottom of this. Crown Control is an essential GATE facility and will be maintained as such.
Chalice, please tell me, I'm rather curious. Why did you carve defense runes onto the shoulders of the Field Bot we loaned you?
he asked
I'm sorry, who asked you to? Was it Altar again? I thought he sorted out his "issues with rank" awhile ago.
the robot

We haven't installed any speech software on F13 to the best of my knowledge. Do you mean "he" indicated it in some way?

I need to remind you that you can't be customizing the loaned equipment when you get bored out in the field, the Field Bot has to perform some very specific maneuvers and I don't want you jamming up his servos or breaching any cabling by accident.
just ask him

Derek, I hold little hope of this reaching you now, but if you receive this, wherever you are, let me know.

That makes no sense, Thomas. I, of all people, know how unreliable T3 readings can be. But thanks for your efforts.

I've instructed Frake's team to install a control point at the persistent perforation location, in case it recurs. It's rather out of the way down there under the dam, but should prevent people accidentally stumbling into it. Of course, it can be reopened with a little effort, if we ever need to.

Lenora gave it a quick look, too, and said it grounded somewhere in Switzerland, would you believe that?
I hear it's nice this time of year.

I am unsure who receives these reports, but for my own sanity, as much as a condition of my employ, I continue to record them.

Yesterday an object fell from the sky and narrowly missed hitting the base. Lacking equipment, I have no way to assess what this object is, or was, but I do not recognize its origin and have heard no reports of any aerial incidents.

I am deeply shaken, and while this is no-one's fault that I am aware of, the sheer inexplicabilty of this event unsettles me profoundly.

At the risk of questioning my senses, I am beginning to wonder whether I am entirely alone here.

At times I imagine I hear breathing, and distant sounds from unknown sources. Objects seem to move or sometimes go missing entirely, and I am conscious, often, of the lingering smell of seafood.

Am I imagining this? Has anyone working at the ASO ever reported such phenomena before?

It is an immense relief to be here at last. I am ready to turn my eyes outward, away from air, weather, storms, climates and clouds, to something altogether bigger.

This is an exceptional opportunity, and I thank ASO for their faith in me.

Journals.Title: BUILD A CRAFTING BENCH
Journals.Note: If I'm going to survive this, I need a place to work.

Journals.Title: EVACUATE THE FACILITY
Journals.Note: The facility PA told me to evacuate, but first I need to get out of the Cafeteria.

Journals.Title: NEED BETTER ARMOR AND WEAPONS
Journals.Note: There's SOLDIERS in the facility? But we can activate the forklift and access Manufacturing Sector using a POWER CELL ... if I can find one.

Journals.Title: EVACUATE VIA MANUFACTURING
Journals.Note: The plaza security guard, Warren, says we have to evacuate via the main tunnel in Manufacturing Sector, on Level 2.

Journals.Title: NEED BETTER ARMOR AND WEAPONS
Journals.Note: There's SOLDIERS in the facility? But we can activate the forklift and access Manufacturing Sector using a POWER CELL ... if I can find one.

Journals.Title: HACK INTO SILO 3?
Journals.Note: The technologist outside Silo 3 thinks we could build a hacking device to break in there. But we'd have to harvest CPUs from Security Bots. How hard could it be?

Journals.Title: GO TO LEVEL 2
Journals.Note: If I want to get out of here, I need to get help from the Security staff

Journals.Title: CRAFT A KEYPAD HACKER
Journals.Note: Looks like security doors in this sector could be vulnerable to hacking. Apparently the CPUs from Security Bots contain security data ...

Journals.Title: BUILD A CRAFTING BENCH
Journals.Note: Not much I can do without setting up a crafting area of some kind.

Journals.Title: WHO IS THE ORDER?
Journals.Note: Sounds like someone powerful has wanted to shut the Cascade Facility down for quite some time.

Journals.Title: GET CPUS FROM SECURITY BOTS
Journals.Note: I need to be careful of the security bots. Apparently, damaging their pods can activate them.

Journals.Title: SPILL THE CRUCIBLE
Journals.Note: If the crucible were to accidentally spill, it could do huge damage to the Foundry

Journals.Title: BUILD A BED
Journals.Note: If I'm going to be here much longer, I need somewhere to sleep. Perhaps I should make a bed?

Journals.Title: GO TO MANUFACTURING
Journals.Note: The scientists who explored Flathill, Abe and Janet, barely survived. Janet says that Manufacturing Sector is our best hope of escape ...

Journals.Title: TEMPORAL TETHERING?
Journals.Note: According to Dr. Arendt, portal destinations reset back to the same moment after a certain period ... temporal tethering?

Journals.Title: FIND FRAKE
Journals.Note: The Engineer holed up in the crane said the soldiers have set up a beachhead at the Crossroads. Maybe I should find a way around them ... through the Garages?

Journals.Title: GET THROUGH MINES
Journals.Note: The engineer, Kovak, talked about spies and sects?! I don't know what to believe, but he said the Surface Tunnel is the way out - if I can disable the security doors somehow.

Journals.Title: OPEN THE PORTAL?
Journals.Note: The dying soldier said opening portals is a bad idea. Then he died.

Journals.Title: PORTAL STORMS
Journals.Note: It seems as though my base isn't quite as secure as I thought, as though I could be attacked at any time. Probably best to put up some proper defenses.

Journals.Title: HELP DR. JAGER
Journals.Note: It doesn't seem like Dr. Thule is going to help Dr. Jager, who's waiting at the cafeteria door.

Journals.Title: THE VENTS?
Journals.Note: Dr. Thule refuses to crawl through vents to let Dr. Jager into the cafeteria.

Journals.Title: INVESTIGATE LEVEL 3 SILOS
Journals.Note: According to Warren, some scientists ignored him and went to the Silos on Level 3, rather than Manufacturing.

Journals.Title: MILITARY IN THE FACILITY?
Journals.Note: The wounded forklift operator told me to find a powercell, so we could use the forklift to open Manufacturing Sector. He also said there's military units in the Facility, but not Gatekeepers or regular army ...

Journals.Title: DEACTIVATE PORTAL DEVICES
Journals.Note: I don't know whether to trust them, but the freak in Flathill thinks I can 'open a way' out by removing power cells from three 'devices' ...

Journals.Title: GET POWER CELLS FROM SILO 3
Journals.Note: If Dr. Roberts is right, there are power cells in the Silos on Level 3.

Journals.Title: POWER CELLS IN SILO 3
Journals.Note: Dr. Regal says his power cells have all been taken to Silo 3.

Journals.Title: SHOOTERS
Journals.Note: The receptionist was hysterical, but said something about people shooting ... ?

Journals.Title: GUN UP
Journals.Note: Janet may have lost the plot, but she's right about one thing: we need GUNS to get out of here.

Journals.Title: OOPS
Journals.Note: It's possible that when we escaped Flathill, we let the Composers out too. Not ideal.

Journals.Title: CRAFTING BENCH
Journals.Note: Dr. Jager thinks I may need to set up somewhere to get to work, if I want to fix this door for him.

Journals.Title: BEACHHEAD
Journals.Note: The Engineer holed up in the crane said the soldiers have set up a beachhead at the Crossroads. Maybe I should find a way around them ... through the Garages?

Journals.Title: THROUGH THE MINES
Journals.Note: The engineer, Kovak, talked about spies and sects?! I don't know what to believe, but he said the Surface Tunnel is the way out - if I can disable the security doors somehow.

Journals.Title: GET PARTS, FOLLOW THE PIPES
Journals.Note:
Frake's team is working with the Blacksmith to make replacement parts for the electron pumps, so they can overload the synchrotron and blow a hole into the next sector.

Once they've got the parts, Frake told her people to follow the colored pipes through Manufacturing - red, yellow, green - that lead to the broken electron pumps.

Journals.Title: REPLACEMENT PARTS
Journals.Note:
The Blacksmith can make the parts we need to fix the electron pumps, but he wants to trade some materials:

-- DIODE -- trade for GREASE
-- FIBREOPTIC CABLE -- trade for SOLDER (melt SILVER and METAL SCRAP in a soup pot with water)
-- OPTIC LENS -- trade for REINFORCED HOSE

The Blacksmith also heard that a portal has opened in the Tram station. He gave me specs for a 'Tram Key' to open the station, so I can investigate the portal, which may lead to useful materials.

Journals.Title: CRAFTY
Journals.Note: According to the Blacksmith, I should head for the Surface Tunnel. But first I need to hack through the Security doors near his workshop. He can also trade items if I bring him materials. Could be useful.

Journals.Title: ESCAPED SPECIMEN
Journals.Note: To judge by the research tape, IS-0091 - the Leyak - is elusive and unstoppable without some kind of x-ray weapon or defense. Unfortunately, it seems to have escaped when the containment system lost power. That could be a problem.

Journals.Title: PORTAL SHORTCUTS
Journals.Note: Apparently, portals tend to ground their entries near their exits. I may be able to use them to find "shortcuts" through the facility ... Could be what I need to get to the Control Center? It's certainly worth a shot.

Journals.Title: HEAVY METAL
Journals.Note: Apparently there are anvils in a supply room on Level 3.

Journals.Title: POWERLESS
Journals.Note: The facility's power and lights turn off at night. I'm going to need to find a way to deal with that.

Journals.Title: SWIM GOOD
Journals.Note: Dr. Hoff says there could be a portal inside the neutrino detector ... and a way out of here ... unfortunately the entrance is underwater, and I don't have gills.

Journals.Title: SURFACE ELEVATOR
Journals.Note: Now the Surface Elevator is out of action, Dr. Ahmed wants to search for equipment that could get us through the Security Doors ...

Journals.Title: WAIT ... AWHILE
Journals.Note: Alice Hong came out of Security Sector, and locked the blast door behind her. Something in there scared the living daylights out of her. There's no way through from this side... Perhaps that's for the best.

Journals.Title: SEARCH CAREFULLY
Journals.Note: Apparently, Pens and the Adjustment Wing both have high tech materials that could be useful. I should search carefully for these.

Journals.Title: IT BURNS
Journals.Note: According to the researchers, there is a material in Anteverse II B that can burn through the webbing that has overrun the vacuum chamber door.

Journals.Title: HYDROPLANT
Journals.Note: Dr. Cahn thinks we can access the Hydroplant if we drain the water from the cave. Sounds reasonable.

Journals.Title: FOLLOW THE PIPES
Journals.Note: Frake told her people to follow the colored pipes through Manufacturing - red, yellow, green - that lead to the broken electron pumps.

Journals.Title: POWER CELLS ON LEVEL 3?
Journals.Note: The receptionist hiding in the closet seems to think there are power cells on Level 3 ... but maybe the soldiers, whoever they are, want the technology too?

Journals.Title: NOT WALKING
Journals.Note: Dr. Shepherd clearly has no interest in walking all the way through Manufacturing to get out of here.

Journals.Title: MAKE IT THROUGH LABS
Journals.Note: The singularity opened an exit to Labs Sector, and Frake's sure there is a way out. Looks like I'm going to have to find it. She's going to round up her team and follow.

Journals.Title: GET TO THE SURFACE TUNNEL
Journals.Note: Hank's trying to stop a chemical meltdown, but he says I should get out of here, and find my way to the Surface Tunnel.

Journals.Title: SEARCH THE CONTAINMENT BLOCK
Journals.Note:
Dr. Cahn believes he can get us to the Surface Elevator in Security Sector, but first I need to retrieve a substance from the Mycofields in Anteverse 2, which removes the webbing on the Vacuum Chamber door.

Apparently there may be a portal in Dr. Laciter's test chamber, wherever that is.

It's better than no plan at all, I suppose.

Journals.Title: BRIDGE THE CHASM
Journals.Note: Cahn thinks I should explore Helmholtz wing, but first I need to find a way across the chasm, without getting shot by those turrets.

Journals.Title: FIND THREE DEVICES
Journals.Note:
If I'm going to open the Spillway's flow control and get out of here, I need to reactivate three devices:

> Reboot Spillway Computer
> Unlock the Flow Valves
> Bring the Central Network Transmitter back online

Journals.Title: GET TO THE CONTROL CENTER
Journals.Note:
Dr. Cahn locked himself in a containment cell for protection, and now he's stuck. He's certain he can get through the Vacuum Chamber to the Surface Elevator, if I can get him out of there.

So I need to find a way to the Control Center, then reset the security system ... How hard could it be?

Journals.Title: ACCESS THE CONTAINMENT BLOCK
Journals.Note: Dr. Thule wants to get through the Vacuum Chamber to the Surface Elevator in Security Sector, but the door is covered in some weird alien goo. He thinks there's tools in the Containment Block to help remove it ... but first, we'd have to find a way past the security systems.

Journals.Title: GET INTO THE CONTAINMENT BLOCK
Journals.Note: Abe and Janet's security clearance has been revoked. They need access to equipment in Containment Block, where they used to work, apparently, although I'm not exactly sure what they're planning ...

Journals.Title: LOCKDOWN
Journals.Note: Abe and Janet made it up here - somehow. They believe the Gatekeepers are preparing to use the Dark Lens to trap us in the facility permanently. That sounds ... dire.

Journals.Title: TIME TO GO
Journals.Note: I don't understand everything the Witch is saying. She's given up hope, as if everything had already happened, and seems to think I will do something ... because I already have? Just when I thought Gatekeepers couldn't get any crazier ...

Journals.Title: HE STAYS, I GO
Journals.Note: Looks like the engineer in the materials processing plant is going down with the ship, but he was clear: I need to head through the mines for the surface tunnel.

Journals.Title: GATEPal
Journals.Note: My GATEPal stores useful data and communications. Assuming it works like the ones at Springer Facility, it'll be locked to my security clearance, so it only provides data for sectors I've got access to.

Journals.Title: ECP
Journals.Note: The sheer range of specimens and entities researched here the GATE Cascade Research Facility, means all staff MUST be familiar with Emergency Containment Protocols.

Journals.Title: POWER
Journals.Note: One of the first things GATE did when it bought this ex-Lithium mine in 1977 was install a completely new power and electrical system. Due to safety regulations, it only operates during daylight hours.

Journals.Title: CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS
Journals.Note: GATE operates several tiers of containment protocols. The lowest is 'Ordo', indicating an item, artefact or entity is deemed benign or low risk and requires only basic precautions. There are several tiers above this, but I'll need a higher security clearance than 'Blue' to learn about them.

Journals.Title: JE NE COMPRENDS
Journals.Note: Dr. Quercy is clearly upset ... and speaking French ... She  seems to be saying something about Voussoir Facility? I wish I understood her better, it could be important ...

Journals.Title: REACTORS LABYRINTH
Journals.Note: Dr. Tang believes there is equipment in Reactors and myriad connections to other parts of the facility ... technology that could assist us, and secret routes that may offer a way out of here ...

Journals.Title: WHO'S WATCHING?
Journals.Note: Sounds like someone in the Research Division is conducting an investigation into security at Cascade.

Journals.Title: REBOOT THE SPILLWAY COMPUTER
Journals.Note: If I want to reboot the Spillway Computer, it's somewhere in the Waterfall Apartments, over the bridge past ... the waterfall.

Journals.Title: UNLOCK THE FLOW VALES
Journals.Note: Unlocking the Flow Valves means finding a way out to the neutrino detector tower in the Reservoir ...

Journals.Title: BRING THE TRANSMITTER ONLINE
Journals.Note:
If I want to bring the Central Network Transmitter back online, it's on top of H Building somewhere, according to Isaiah. Something is interfering with the signal. I need to find a way to restore it.

Apparently the flow control module's up there too ...

Alright.

Journals.Title: WHO IS FRAKE?
Journals.Note: The engineer, Julia, says that someone called 'Frake' has a plan to get out of here, and it involves ... the Blacksmith, apparently.

Journals.Title: ICHOR
Journals.Note: It sounds like Dr. Laciter, whoever that is, was looking for a way to open portals using Tarasque blood? I wonder if he succeeded ...

Journals.Title: DARK LENS
Journals.Note: Dr. Newman says the invaders removed the Dark Lens, unleashing portal chaos on the facility.

Journals.Title: X-RAY FORCE FIELDS
Journals.Note: The way forward is blocked by some kind of physical "X-RAY+" field. I may be able to jam the system by putting in something that responds abnormally to x-ray.

Journals.Title: BIG JUICE
Journals.Note: Dr. Peters is the only survivor of the team that trapped the Tarasque in Containment. She says its fluids are powerful enough to sustain an entire portal network, but getting them ... is another question

Journals.Title: ESSENTIAL
Journals.Note: Apparently IS-0091 - the Leyak - produces a unique substance when exposed to high energy x-rays ...

Journals.Title: TWISTED SISTER
Journals.Note: I just met a Gatekeeper. She told me that beyond lay darkness ... and depths where we 'could not co-exist' ... What on earth is she trying to warn me about ... ?

Journals.Title: WHAT LIES BEYOND
Journals.Note: Dr. Cahn said something about 'unimaginable creatures', then told me to find a way to the Surface Elevator in the center of this Sector.

Journals.Title: SURVIVORS?
Journals.Note:
The Defense Team officer, Jonas, thinks there could be survivors of the Order attack in the Electrical Station.

If anyone knows this sector, it's going to be them.

Journals.Title: GATEKEEPERS GONE
Journals.Note:
Jonas, a member of the Defense Team, says that the Gatekeepers abandoned his team to defend the Dam alone, and pushed on towards Reactors.

He's not sure what's so important for them down in Reactors, but they don't sound like the types to answer questions.

Journals.Title: FIX THE BRIDGE
Journals.Note:
Kylie, whoever she was, seems to have had her brain installed into a machine, and now that Wakeman is gone, she's trapped in there.

She believes that if I can repair the neural-bridge, she may be able to 'upload' into some kind of hardware.

How hard could it be?

Journals.Title: YETI?
Journals.Note: Dr. Dupont believes there may be a portal in the Yeti containment zone, wherever that is ... but attempting to reach it would be extremely dangerous.

Journals.Title: UNLOST, FOUND
Journals.Note: The cryptic Gatekeeper made one thing clear: the way is open.

Journals.Title: INTERFERENCE
Journals.Note: Dr. Tang suggested that we could reactivate the Central Transmitter by devising a piece of equipment to shield it from the radiation surge that's interfering with it.

Journals.Title: RESET THE POWER SYSTEM
Journals.Note: Isaiah says the first thing we should do is reset the Dam power system after the quakes triggered a shutdown.

Journals.Title: X-RAY POWER
Journals.Note: It sounds like there's an aquatic subject, IS-0023, that REALLY doesn't like x-ray radiation ...

Journals.Title: IT HATES HIGH ENERGY EM
Journals.Note: It sounds like IS-0059 produces an unusual material when struck with certain kinds of high energy EM radiation.

Journals.Title: COLD WELCOME
Journals.Note: It appears the guardsman of this strange community believes I'm some kind of witch or demon. He's rather disinclined to let me in. I may have to find another way.

Journals.Title: ANY WITCH WAY
Journals.Note:
Dr. Riggs has been hiding out in the swamp for weeks, but believes the Lodestone contains components that could help repair the GATE portal equipment. 

If I can find a way to disassemble the Lodestone, perhaps by using the anvil in the village, I may be able to reactivate our damaged perforation gear.

She seems certain the manic village preacher has something to do with it, and I'm likely to find him in the chapel on the hilltop.

Journals.Title: HIDING IN PLAIN SIGHT
Journals.Note:
The folksy fisherman is actually a stranded GATE scientist! He came here to study the area, but it seems his team was attacked and several of them killed.

Dr. Riggs could still be alive, and may even know how to get out of here. But if so, getting to her in the swamp sounds ... complicated, although he didn't say why. He's scared to blow his cover, and didn't want to talk long.

Journals.Title: FROM THE ASHES
Journals.Note: The faintly discernable remains of an ID card in the ashes appear to say "Dr. Felicia Mitter - TransRecon 2."

Journals.Title: SICK CROWNS
Journals.Note:
Commander Fili says there's something wrong with the Royal Range, a sickness that's changed things ...

If I want to get out of here, she told me to collect 8 Royal Crowns, whatever those are.

Journals.Title: THROUGH THE PORTAL
Journals.Note: The Waterbot says the exit from Power Services to Reactors is blocked by a strange fungal bloom. It has seen other GATE staff escape through the portal in the center. I don't know where that leads, but it may be my only option ...

Journals.Title: OLD PORTAL
Journals.Note: Dr. Manse says the portal in this area is one of GATE's oldest. It connects to another location in Anteverse II, where this biological infestation is emanating from - and not for the first time, apparently.

Journals.Title: FIND THE KILL SWITCH
Journals.Note: Dr. Riggs believes that somewhere in the Exor Village lies a secret 'kill switch' that can undo all manner of life, potentially removing this infestation of Anteverse fungus, which is covering the center of Power Services.

Journals.Title: EXPELLED
Journals.Note: I don't know what just happened, but I'm not feeling welcomed.

Journals.Title: I DON'T REMEMBER WRITING THIS
Journals.Note: Choosing something that cannot be undone I was seen by myriad eyes of [UNTRANSLATEABLE].

Journals.Title: GATEKEEPER EGRESS
Journals.Note:
Gatekeepers have overun the Reactors - neo-mauraders, insane special ops employed by GATE to deal with the most dangerous entities in our world. Today, apparently, that includes me.

Dr. Cahn says the Gatekeepers enter and exit the facility via some kind of waygate, but they've shut down the nuclear reactors that power it. Each reactor has a unique name.

I need to power them back on, starting with Dusk Reactor.

Journals.Title: POWER ON
Journals.Note:
Dr. Cahn has been digging around, and says the Gatekeepers' waygate is powered by a Fusion Generator in the center of the sector. 

If we want to reopen the portal, we have to reactivate all four Nuclear Reactors needed to ignite the Fusion Generator.

He thinks restoring power to Dusk Reactor may have opened the way to Cloud Reactor.

Journals.Title: FOUR FLAMES
Journals.Note: Dr. Hill wants to get the four nuclear reactors back online, so he can ignite the Fusion Generator, restore power to this sector, and start getting it back to ... something like normal. He's optimistic, I'll give him that.

Journals.Title: POWERLESS
Journals.Note: It sounds like Dr. Tengku is getting close to breaking point. I guess she's been stuck down here long enough. All she wants is to get out of here.

Journals.Title: DOWN THE HOLE
Journals.Note: Frake was looking for a way out, and it sounds like she had a similar idea - get the waygate back online.

Journals.Title: DOUG-LESS
Journals.Note: I'm not convinced this guy knows anything useful. I'm actually wondering how he got his job in the first place.

Journals.Title: THE DANCE
Journals.Note: Even by her standards, the Sister of the Unlost is speaking in riddles. Something about hearing unheard music and ceasing a dance, but ... I'm still dancing? None of this makes any sense. If she knows something, she sure isn't telling me.

Journals.Title: IGNITION TIME
Journals.Note: Dr. Hill says that now all four nuclear reactors are online, we can ignite the Fusion Generator ... if we can just get past the eletrical mishap.

Journals.Title: DESTROY THE CONTAINMENT
Journals.Note: Dr. Cahn believes we owe a debt as scientists to send this creature back into the abyss from which it came, and undo the madness of the Gatekeepers.

Journals.Title: THE ONLY WAY
Journals.Note: Things just get weirder and weirder, but this much is clear: there's only one way forward, and that's through the Intrados - er, Shadowgate - facility. Maybe I need to prepare for this and find a way to bring down their shielding.

Journals.Title: HEAT RAY
Journals.Note:
The Order Inquisitor, Hasta Tria, is encouraging me to make my way through the Praetorium to the so-called Sun Disk. 

He claims interaction with the Sun Disk will help me survive the absolute zero chill in the Residence Sector.

Should I trust this strange, wheezing conspirator?

Journals.Title: CATS AND DOGS
Journals.Note: Abe and Janet seem to have made it through relatively unscathed - somehow - but they're not particularly impressed with the state of things in Reactors.

Journals.Title: LOST LARVA
Journals.Note: If I understand what it's saying, the Larva creature seems to be lost, as if it has no idea how it came to be here.

Journals.Title: ON CANAAN'S SIDE
Journals.Note:
The Order believe GATE is on the brink of discovering something called a 'Lodestone' via a 'rift' in the Particle Lab. 

They seem desperate to gain possession of it, but have not yet succeeded.

Journals.Title: ENLIGHTENED
Journals.Note:
Hasta Tria says that touching the Sun Disk has rendered me impervious to the unearthly chill of the Residence Sector, so I am ready to venture forth to find the Dark Lens.

We shall see.

Journals.Title: COLD IMPASSE
Journals.Note: The upper reaches of Residences is engulfed in a lethally cold perforation storm. Abe and Janet suggest there may be equipment to help penetrate the ice wall somewhere in the Residence Sector, but first, we need to complete the portal suppression device in the Athletics area.

Journals.Title: SHIFT WORK
Journals.Note: It seems I managed to pass the Sun Disk's 'touch' to Jimmy, the taco stand guy. Interesting.

Journals.Title: NONE IS TRUE
Journals.Note:
I feel like the Sister of the Unlost is trying to tell me something, about a place I'm going to go, or come back from ... or have already been?

Clear as mud, as usual.

Journals.Title: NO END
Journals.Note:
The Unlost SIster says 'all that was persists'.

Am I supposed to feel better?

Journals.Title: I, ANOMALY
Journals.Note:
I found my way somewhere extremely unexpected, a GATE facility I'd never heard of. I was held prisoner and then released, in order to avoid a 'temporal break' ... apparently.

What did they mean? Who was that woman speaking? Where was that place?

Journals.Title: LOCKDOWN
Journals.Note: Dr. Shepherd is convinced that Keystone sent the Gatekeepers in to retrieve the Dark Lens, and make sure nothing - and no-one - else escaped. A straightforward clean-up job?

According to Dr. Cahn, I just need to find a way through the ice sheath encasing the Shopping District, then locate the Gatekeepers, overpower them, and use the Dark Lens to get out of here ...

No problem.

Journals.Title: IT CANNOT BE PERMITTED
Journals.Note: Dr. Riggs says that it's essential we prevent the Gatekeepers leaving with the Dark Lens, or the rest of the world is in serious trouble.

Journals.Title: MULTIVERSE?
Journals.Note: Dr. Riggs seems to be suggesting it might be time to find a new universe. I wish her luck, but I'm still fairly attached to this one. ... More or less.

Journals.Title: ALTARPIECE
Journals.Note: Dr. Cahn and Dr. Thule differ on most things - including, apparently, whether Dr. Cahn is even human - but it seems likely that activating the altar on the hill is our only way off this island.

Journals.Title: THE LONG CAHN
Journals.Note:
I can't quite believe it. Dr. Cahn just admitted he is actually an I.S. So he isn't Dr. Cahn at all! Who could have seen this coming?!

Can he be trusted? He just seems to want to go home, though, like the rest of us.

Journals.Title: ABE IS MISSING
Journals.Note: Janet has lost track of Abe. Hopefully only temporarily, and not temporally.

Journals.Title: ROBODY
Journals.Note: If I understand this email exchange correctly, Dr. Wakeman had a plan to upload someone named Kylie into a robot body, and he was working on it in a laboratory somewhere in the Botanical Wing.

Journals.Title: FROMAGE
Journals.Note: Dr. Wakeman has been experimenting with neuro-transference technology, if the strange box in his closet is any confirmation. ... And it really wants cheese.

Journals.Title: SECRET PROJECTS
Journals.Note: According to Abe, many researchers had private projects they worked on in their rooms, especially Dr. Wakeman. There may be equipment in one of their dorms that we could help us get through the ice shroud into the Shopping District, once we've sorted out this storm situation.

Journals.Title: THROUGH THE LOOKING GLASS
Journals.Note:
Dr. Newman suggests there's a crew of Gatekeepers at the top of Botanical Wing who may have a way through the force field.

I hope it's who I think it is.

Journals.Title: QUIET ON THE WESTERN FRONT
Journals.Note: Whatever this place is ... it looks like someone wasn't getting the help they needed ...

Journals.Title: SUB PROBLEM
Journals.Note:
The ASO Substation is malfunctioning, and Dr. Hud apparently thinks I'm here to help fix it.

Couldn't hurt to try.

According to Dr. Hud, the Substation is up the path at the righthand corner of the car park.

Journals.Note:
The console on Satellite Dish M has some kind of problem. Dr. Hud sounds spooked and wants me to take a look.

It's on the other side of the river from the base, up on the hill, to the west of the wind turbines.

Journals.Title: PEER REVIEW

Signals received by the array are experiencing heavy interference from an unknown cause.

Dr. Hud mentioned there may be useful research on signal interference in Dr. Sun's abandoned office.

Journals.Title: A WALK IN THE DARK

Journals.Title: LOUD AND CLEAR

Journals.Title: A RESET
Journals.Note:
Dr. Hud believes Satellite Dish D needs to be reset, then the system will fully operational.

We'll see.

Dish D is northeast, across the river, below the wind turbines.

Journals.Title: BE HERE NOW
Journals.Note: Dr. Hud wants you to come back to the base and see something ... urgently.

Journals.Title: PERSISTENT PORTAL

Journals.Note: Whatever Dr. Hud was expecting when he took on this job, I'm fairly sure it wasn't this ... whatever 'this' was.

Compendium.Title: G.A.S.S.
Compendium.Subtitle: Security Bot
SectionTexts:
Designed to protect GATE Facilities from internal threats, the GATE Automated Security Sentience (G.A.S.S.) program was initiated in 1985 after the infamous Torii Facility 'Decompression' event.

The aim of the project remains to create fully sentient artificial intelligence, but at present the robots are best suited to patrol operations in low-security sectors and keeping the vending machines well-stocked.

Compendium.Title: G.A.I.A.
Compendium.Subtitle: Containment Bot
SectionTexts: A recent addition to the GATE's security apparatus, the GATE Automated Immurement Automaton, or "Containment Bot" for short, builds on the Security Bot architecture originally designed by Dr. Alice Mayfield by adding immurement protocols devised by Dr. Stewart Wakeman. The unit is currently undergoing field evaluation at the Cascade Research Facility.

Compendium.Title: G.A.D.D.
Compendium.Subtitle: Defense Bot
SectionTexts:
An advancement on the original G.A.S.S. 'Security Bot' designed by Dr. Alice Mayfield and Dr. Stewart Wakeman, the Gate Automated Defense Droid is a militarized prototype currently undergoing field tests.

Deployed prematurely during the Order's invasion, the unit's friend/foe distinction capabilities are a work in progress. Notably, the tendency of its rear power unit to explode under heavy damage is yet to be rectified.

Compendium.Title: G.E.A.R.
Compendium.Subtitle: Expedition Assistant Bot
SectionTexts: Originally intended as a tool for TransRecon teams, the GATE Expedition Assistant Robot has been seeing more and more use in the field by the Gatekeepers, who use it to help contain, constrain, scout, and distract. Some of the robotics that return from the field appear to have [DATA REDACTED].

Compendium.Title: Order: Triarii
Compendium.Subtitle: Grunt
SectionTexts: Trained as thoroughly in gnostic theology as close-quarter battle tactics, the Order's Triarii are conditioned to overcome enemies both physical and spiritual. Battle-hardened by years of clandestine deployments, Triarii are the Order's first, finest and usually final footsoldiers.
The Order's Latinate dialect has changed markedly over the years, evolving from its classical origins into a unique, almost impenetrable language entirely its own.

Compendium.Title: Order: Legate
Compendium.Subtitle: Captain
SectionTexts:
Legates of the Order achieve their command through a mixture of zealotry, combat victories, and sheer survival.

Although the Order conducts extensive intelligence gathering in advance of any operation, a Legate’s role frequently involves leadership under unexpected, if not extraordinary conditions. As such, those who earn the role are trusted with a high degree of operational independence.
Legates are among the Order's most fervent believers, and sometimes called 'Perfecti', in acknowledgement of their Cathar-derived traditions.

Compendium.Title: Order: Exsurgo
Compendium.Subtitle: Medic
SectionTexts: Soldier-medics grounded in traditions spanning more than two millennia, the Exsurgo are trained by the Order to operate under vastly more varied conditions than their conventional military counterparts.

Exsurgo must be ready to provide care under any conditions imaginable. A new conflict may see them confronted with crystalline claw wounds, psychic assault traumas, razor tentacle injuries and a panoply of other barely conceivable harms. 

Until they have demonstrated this capacity, aspirants are designated as Refectio. Only when satisfied that a candidate has the requisite ability to both heal and defend under almost any circumstances, does the Princeps Medicus bestow the title 'Exsurgo'.

Compendium.Title: Order: Inquisitor
Compendium.Subtitle: Lab Rat
SectionTexts: Charged with the noble but corrupting task of assessing the anomalies and aberrations seized by their organization from its enemies, Inquisitors are one of the most essential yet mistrusted elements of the Order's ancient apparatus.

The Inquisitors are driven by a relentless curiosity in their service of the Order. They are tolerated, but not beloved, and only by fiat of the Praetors are they permitted such leniency and command.

While their methods do not always sit comfortably with the tenets of their ancient fraternity, these field investigators - largely - direct their study towards the greater good of their brethren, even if it means trampling a few lesser regulations along the way.

Compendium.Title: Order: Exulum
Compendium.Subtitle: Breacher
SectionTexts:
Held in disdain by their bretheren for lapses of honor or, worse, spiritual failing, the Exulum are forced into the role of shock troops as penance.

Their barred helmets represent their position as pariahs, forced to take the frontline until they have redeemed themselves in battle. Their ferocity reflects a faith that admits no further failure.

Compendium.Title: Order: Sagittari
Compendium.Subtitle: Sniper
SectionTexts: Tracing the lineage of their discipline to Roman archery schools in Parthia of the 2nd Century BCE, the Sagittari are the ultra-clandestine core of an already secretive sect.

Compendium.Title: Order: Saboter
Compendium.Subtitle: Sapper
SectionTexts:
The Saboter of the Order are often sent alongside heavy troopers to destroy infrastructure.

Their lineage goes back to - and beyond - the siege of Constantinople, where they undermined the walls of palaces and other fortifications to break prolonged sieges.

While some Saboter are volunteers, many are initially placed in this role as a punishment for Inquisitorial failings. Others see it as a pivotal role in bringing down the very structures that support the pomposity of man.

Compendium.Title: Order: Purgati
Compendium.Subtitle: Flame Rat
SectionTexts: For some, deployment to the Purgati is a blessing - a chance to cleanse the world of threats in the rawest, most literal sense. For others, it is closer to purgatory - strapped to a tank of a strange diesel mixture and pressed toward the frontline.

Like the Saboters, Purgati draw their recruits from the ranks of Inquisitors. It is an opportunity to redeem the suspicion that this branch of the Order is held in - to employ technology in the service of protecting humanity, while expunging the reputation for cowardice that attends them.

In any case, they are far from the first to equate knowledge with flesh and flame.

Compendium.Title: Order: Opprimo
Compendium.Subtitle: Rook
SectionTexts:
Among the most savage Order infantry, the Opprimo eschew ranged weapons for close quarter combat. Their creed holds that, like spiritual knowledge itself, the intimacy of combat demands an unmediated encounter with the enemy. Sharing blood is a sacred act.

They are often deployed for specialist engagements, frequently taking on the guise of other paramilitaries for infiltration missions.

Compendium.Title: Order: Interfector
Compendium.Subtitle: Assassin
SectionTexts:
The secrets of the Interfector sect have been successfully guarded for fifteen centuries, and known only to select Praetors whom they ritualistically assent to obey.

A savage pulse at the Order's heart, Interfectors pursue the aims of their cause with an intensity that eclipses even their most zealous brethren.
The exact source of the Interfector's faith and fervor remains obscure, even to the majority of their Order allies, but is rumoured to involve secret visions of the captive St. Asella.

Compendium.Title: Order: Clericum
Compendium.Subtitle: Archivist
SectionTexts:
The Clericum are those members of the Order entrusted to guard and grow the knowledge accumulated by the sect over more than two millennia.

Trained from youth to protect, process and promulgate information from the Order's extraordinary archives, the Clericum exist in order to serve and sustain the Great Library and its many subsidiary archives. 

While no individual Clericus ever sees combat, the intelligence and advice they provide to those in the field is indispensable: experts in translation and hermeneutics, masters of archival research and practices, artists of exegesis and accession, the Clericum's dedication underwrites the very existence of the Order itself.

Compendium.Title: Canaanite
Compendium.Subtitle: Follower of the Path of Petrae
SectionTexts:
Simple folk from sundry backgrounds, the locals of Canaan regard themselves as having adopted plain, pious lives far from the clamor and corruption of the wider world - hitherto unknown.

In reality, they follow their preacher Niketas blindly, accepting his edicts as 'the Path of Petrae'.

Hostile to any and all outsiders, the Canaanites see the works of 'the Enemy' everywhere, and one may be deemed a witch without even being aware. Indeed, the world, in their eyes, is one vast machine of deception, and anyone not 'of the Path' is - by definition - a tool of evil.

It would seem their diet, based heavily on a rather corrupted corn strain, has not helped with their critical thinking.

Compendium.Title: The Spear
Compendium.Subtitle: Gatekeeper Chieftain
SectionTexts:
Chieftains represent the most senior Gatekeeper commanders: individuals who have observed and absorbed all that the many universes can throw at them - and prevailed.

If there is a single characteristic shared by those who achieve this rank, it is the plausible expectation of victory under any imaginable circumstances.

Compendium.Title: The Tested
Compendium.Subtitle: Gatekeeper Neophyte
SectionTexts:
Neophytes are entry-level Gatekeepers, relatively recent initiates to the organization.

The moniker 'Phyter' is a shortened, derogatory term for newer Gatekeepers who have yet to earn a distinct specialization. Most recruits embrace it for the many years - sometimes decades - that it takes to specialize in the wilder ways of our many worlds.

There is no single place that Neophytes are drawn from. Military hospitals, special forces drop outs, special forces retirees, prisons, private military contractors, even seminaries and the occasional psych ward, by Assessors with an eye for anyone ‘attuned to the unseen’.

In essence, all recruits are unstable, and GATE is the stabilizing compound. The aim of all Neophyte training is to create a living weapon who enjoys staring down an anomalous entity while making bets on who flinches first.

Compendium.Title: The Bulwark
Compendium.Subtitle: Gatekeeper Jotun
SectionTexts: Given the panoply of traditions that Gatekeepers draw from, the origin of ‘Jotun’ title remains unspecified. Regardless, the title lends its name to both this echelon of Gatekeeper and the clandestine bio-enhancement program run by Synaptic Labs that produces these living titans.

Compendium.Title: The Abyssal
Compendium.Subtitle: Gatekeeper Mystagogue
SectionTexts:
Those Gatekeepers who have delved most deeply into the arcane, Mystagogues typically come from backgrounds of direct or indirect communion with other-worldly or supernatural entities.

There is no single path for a Mystagogue: their ranks boast witch doctors, priestesses, brujos and shaman. As such, their relationship with the numinous or occult can take many forms. A common thread, however, is an unusual curiosity, even doubt about the true nature of their gods or divinities.

Compendium.Title: The Hexan
Compendium.Subtitle: Gatekeeper Witch
SectionTexts:
Whether you think of them as witches, druids, magic-users, or any of the multitude of names and titles accrued over the millennia, Gatekeeper Witches are something else again. They are both seer and soldier - mystic mercenaries who have more than parted the veil.

They have torn it down and used it as a cape.

Compendium.Title: Office Sector
Compendium.Subtitle: Administration and Management
SectionTexts: The Office Sector is the GATE Cascade Research Facility's main center of administration, and comprises 12 levels, as well as several repurposed silos. Once used for storing gas, water and ore, these immense spaces now house key perforation research systems.

Compendium.Title: Manufacturing West
Compendium.Subtitle: Engineering and Fabrication
SectionTexts:
The industrial heart of the GATE Cascade Research Facility, the Manufacturing Sector is responsible for designing and engineering all research equipment and machinery for study within the facility - as well as fabricating technical and specialist tools for other GATE facilities.

It is here the facility's origins as a decommissioned lithium mine are most clearly visible.

Compendium.Title: Cascade Laboratories
Compendium.Subtitle: Advanced Study and Containment
SectionTexts:
Labs Sector is the epicenter of the GATE Cascade Research Facility's research into advanced technology, as well as anomalies, xenoforms, paranormal phenomenon, arcane entities and artefacts of note.

Providing secure immurment for entities rated up to Thela level, Labs is divided into various sub-sectors focused variously on containment, advanced studies and field research.

Compendium.Title: Security Sector
Compendium.Subtitle: Cascade Defense Sector
SectionTexts:
Officially designated the Cascade Defense Sector, the Security Sector sits at the center of the GATE Cascade Research Facility.

The sector was built as a self-sufficient, defensible 'home' for the GATE Defense Team, who are trusted with ensuring the physical, technical and informational safety of all staff and subjects.

At the core of the sector is one of GATE's main arteries to the outside world: the Large Surface Elevator. Connecting the subterranean facility to the rest of world, it is the fastest way to get into or out of the facility

Compendium.Title: Hydroplant Sector
Compendium.Subtitle: Cascade Reservoir and Dam
SectionTexts:
Completed in 1969 to advance the energy needs of the original Cascade Lithium Mine, the GATE Hydropower Plant is the world’s only subterranean hydropower system.

Following GATE’s purchase of the facility in 1977, 'The Dam' was heavily refurbished and now delivers up to 400MW. It provides power to the facility and specialist sub-systems, including the GATE Fusion Research Unit located directly beneath this cavern.

Providing more than just power, the Cascade Reservoir is also home to GATE’s Neutrino Detection Apparatus, an ever-growing suite of advanced experiments and investigations, and a local glow worm colony.

Compendium.Title: Rise
Compendium.Subtitle: GATE Rise Bio-Laboratory
SectionTexts: The Rise Bio-Laboratory is the center of GATE's research into biotechnology, virology, genetics and associated fields. Occupying the building's top eight levels, very few occupants of the floors below - or the city beyond - are more than vaguely aware of the details of GATE's operations here.

Compendium.Title: Voussoir
Compendium.Subtitle: GATE Voussoir Facility
SectionTexts:
The GATE Voussoir Facility is mandated to research 'notable and unusual macro-phenomena' and all this entails.

The facility's ELT is one of the largest private telescopes in existence, offering insight into celestial events and entities unavailable to most institutions, as well as powerful local and deep space monitoring capabilities.

Voussoir is also positioned to allow staff to conduct essential research into telluric control and geomagnetic countermeasures - providing essential data for GATE's perforation research around the globe, as well as prototyping and testing a range of experimental EM equipment.

Necessarily, Voussoir's position has seen it become a containment facility for locally endemic immurement subjects until they can be housed in purpose-built environments.

Compendium.Title: Torii
Compendium.Subtitle: GATE Torii Facility
SectionTexts:
The GATE Torii Facility is a secluded institute dedicated to advanced power research and supernormal studies.

Focused on energy science in all its forms, Torii stands at the cutting edge of knowledge in the fields of energy generation, propagation, storage and transmission, as well as fuel extraction and many emergent sub-disciplines.

Located in Southern Japan, its deliberate placement on the 'Ring of Fire' reflects its longstanding engagement in volcanology and geothermal research.

Torii is also the site of GATE's specialist study unit on Supernormal Historical Events.

Compendium.Title: Anteverse 23
Compendium.Subtitle: The Furniture Store
SectionTexts:
Anteverse 23 was assessed by TR investigators to have been a luxury furniture outlet. However this location, and the surrounding region, is believed to have suffered a systemic collapse following an aggressive viral outbreak. 

Data is inconclusive, and GATE is currently investigating the source and cause of this calamity, including its precise location in space and time.

Compendium.Title: Anteverse 39
Compendium.Subtitle: The Night Realm
SectionTexts:
First brought to GATE's attention in 1991 following the initial appearance of IS-0059 in the Cascade Research Facility, little is known about the origins or purpose of Anteverse 39, or the precise nature of its connection to IS-0059.

Due in part to the unpredictability of access, there have been no successful TransRecon or Gatekeeper expeditions to this location, and while ██ personnel are believed to have been translocated there by IS-0059, none have subsequently returned.

In the absence of substantive or reliable data, research remains speculative. Dr. Hammond suggests Anteverse 39 is not one but a series of 'psycho-nests', however his theories have received little support among other GATE staff. At this time, all of Dr. Hammond's proposed sleep studies have been denied.

Compendium.Title: Anteverse 168
Compendium.Subtitle: Canaan
SectionTexts:
Reliable data on Anteverse 168 is currently limited, but it is believed to be an occupied, Earth-like world.

A preliminary TransRecon expedition has been dispatched, led by Dr. Lenora Riggs. 

Her report is pending.

While data on areas of Anteverse 168 beyond the coastal settlement of Canaan remains limited, several things are now known about the location and its inhabitants.

The remote area is occupied by a small gnostic cult, whose creed holds that material reality was created as a cage for their sublime, immortal souls.

Worshipping a piece of xenotechnology known as the Lodestone, which they believe may be the key to releasing them from their physical bondage, they follow a puritanical regime of self-abasement, regarding all others as tools of 'the enemy', who created their fetters, i.e. matter. 

How this group came to settle in this remote region, whether it represents the past, present or future of this or some other Earth entirely, and how they came into possession of an artefact like the Lodestone is unknown.

Compendium.Title: Anteverse 188
Compendium.Subtitle: North Pole
SectionTexts:
Anteverse 188 is regarded by GATE researchers as a stable self-nucleated spatial 'exception'.

Believed to be a refuge outside our universe, it may constitute an actual Anteverse, but those studying it argue whether it technically qualifies - seeming to exist precisely nowhere, there is nothing detectable beyond its bounds. Optical measurements indicate the glass is between 10 and 15 meters thick, but no data has been successfully garnered beyond that. Neither can it be directly exited. As such, the entity is currently classified as an 'exception'. Dr. Martin Jessup notes that Anteverse 188 may bear similarities to Anteverse 11's superpositional state.

That is not to say one cannot leave. TransRecon Team 4 noted an intense density of perforation signatures connecting several locations on Earth. These are frequent enough to have 'imprinted' on the local continuum, and appear to cluster seasonally, as if heavy perforation traffic occurred regularly, for certain brief periods.

Anteverse 188's origins have provoked an unusual amount of debate among GATE researchers.

The region appears to represent an 'idealized space' brought into being by forces unknown, and governed by laws that GATE staff are yet to fully fathom. At some stage in A188's history, it would also seem that a secondary entity was introduced: IS-0127, one of the more curious - and potentially dangerous - subjects yet encountered by GATE.

Further, Anteverse 188 appears to present a psychical hazard. The first GATE scientist who visited Anteverse 188, Dr. Simon Harkness (TransRecon Team 4), seems to have become compelled to don specific festive clothing items and return to the location. He now refuses to leave, except on certain dates - and then only briefly. No amount of intervention, restraint or therapy has managed to persuade him otherwise. At this time, Dr. Harkness is checked in on bi-weekly by project staff while further investigation continues.

Dr. Martin Jessup has speculated that the psychical threat of IS-0127 is part of its fundamental nature: in 'forging the Snow Globe from an internal blueprint, memory or mental image', its creator ignored their own 'subconscious vectors', which also formed a part of the creation. IS-0127 may therefore have been, Jessup suggests, 'accidentially instantiated in the same act of creation as the Snow Globe itself'.

In contrast, Dr. Daria Kale has proposed that Anteverse 188 is little more than an elaborate trap mechanism, created by or for IS-0127 itself, to imprison or liquidate another, unidentified entity. In her words, 'the A188 / 0127 complex suggests a lethal lure or attempt to ensnare some unknown organism, of which IS-0127 is either a predator or, possibly, nemesis.'

There have been a handful of reported sightings of a secondary humanoid entity, tentatively designated IS-0105-B, but no contact has been made. Options for further investigation are currently before GATE's Research Ethics Committee.

Compendium.Title: IS-0083-H
Compendium.Subtitle: Royal Range
SectionTexts:
The eighth of fifteen 'worlds' in Space Queen, Royal Range (featured in the in-game level "Rumble on the Royal Range") is theorized to be a simulated environment running on highly advanced processing equipment within IS-0083.

A mid-difficulty design, Royal Range sits between Painted Planet and Mighty Moon, challenging players to open the way by collecting a number of Royal Crowns. IS-0083's incorporation of the players' complete current awareness (CCA) results in no single correct solution set, given the variance of equipment each player's awareness may introduce into the environment.

Subsequent to its theorized infection by IS-0307, Rumble on the Royal Range is the only level available to players. Players are ejected from the simulation upon completing its requirements and cannot progress further into the game. Previous to infection, players had reported prior and subsequent levels all the way up to the final boss, but completion immediately returns players to the starting screen. Dr. Hammond reported an impressive full-game completion time of 3 and one-half hours by a Mr. Beckett, of Janitorial.

Due to infection, the regular enemies in Royal Range also have heightened aggression, likewise associated with IS-0307, but the greater effects of which are still being studied.

Compendium.Title: Power Services
Compendium.Subtitle: Energy Generation and Distribution
SectionTexts:
The energy requirements of the GATE Cascade Research Facility are immense - whether providing power for the demands of day-to-day research or the extraordinary requirements of perforation activation and study.

While Dr. Elanor Newman's invention of the Dark Lens drastically reduced the energy costs of perforation technology, Power Services remains one of the oldest and most essential elements of the Facility.

It was here that GATE performed their first successful on-site perforation experiments, and continue to conduct some of its most exploratory research.

Compendium.Title: The Reactors
Compendium.Subtitle: Wave, Dusk, Gale, Mist, Cloud
SectionTexts:
The epicenter of GATE's energy research, the Reactor Complex (or simply 'the Reactors') are set within the deepest region of the Facility.

The four primary reactors in this sector provide energy to the Facility at large, as well as ignition power for the highly experimental Fusion Generator that lay at the heart.

Due to the nature of Gatekeeper operations, the area also acts as a transit zone to and from [DATA REDACTED].

Compendium.Title: GATE Intrados Containment Facility
Compendium.Subtitle: Shadowgate
SectionTexts:
GATE gained ownership of this location in [the late 1980s] after [DATA REDACTED]. It was immediately purposed as a center for Gatekeeper operations, due to its transpositional nature and access to [DATA REDACTED]. Gatekeepers were instrumental in [DATA REDACTED] the jurisdictional issues regarding the Intrados Facility.

Precise data on entities immured there, or specific activities within its walls are limited to Keystone clearance or higher. All records of the Intrados Facility can be requested through the Section Three office at Keystone, but it is the opinion of this documentation author that you are unlikely to get any satisfactory response.

Compendium.Title: Praetorium
Compendium.Subtitle: Order Headquarters
SectionTexts: The Order's prima domus for more than two millennia, the Praetorium is both an ancient center of operations and a highly secure study facility: home, garrison, fortress, foundation, vault - it is all this and more.

Supremus Ordo Petrae addresses itself to the needs of humanity through a range of outward-facing institutions. Only its initiates, however, are permitted entry to the Praetorium.

In the history of the organisation, only three people outside the Order's ranks are ever believed to have gained access to this bastion. Only one was permitted to leave.

Compendium.Title: Residence Sector
Compendium.Subtitle: Cascade Residential Sector
SectionTexts:
A high-capacity accommodation sector for staff of the GATE Cascade Research Facility, the Residential Sector is a home away from home for personnel who may be on site for weeks at a time - and often longer.

Including shared accommodation for up to nine hundred people, an executive wing, recreation facilities, and even a shopping district, this sector is often simply referred to as 'Residences'.

Built on the pre-existing mine site accommodation, it was designed by the late and renowned Indonesian architect Giring Mohede, before being extensively refitted and re-opened in late 1979.

Compendium.Title: GATE Arch Defense Facility
Compendium.Subtitle: Unknown
SectionTexts:
There is no information available on the GATE Arch Defense Facility in the Compendium database.

As far as this Compendium is concerned, such a facility appears not to exist.

Compendium.Title: GATE Finial Observation Facility
Compendium.Subtitle: The [REDACTED] Islands
SectionTexts:
Presenting to the world as an ornithological research station, the GATE Finial Observation Facility is the organization's most recently established institute.

Situated on the [REDACTED] Islands, the facility's site was chosen for the extraordinary convergence of geomagnetic and telluric forces that meet approximately 6 kilometers offshore and 3 kilometers deep, beneath the seabed. While even more intense loci are theorized to exist deeper in the planet's interior, no site known on the Earth's surface presents a more intense force nexus this close to the surface.

The [REDACTED] Islands are the site of a megalithic trilithon structure whose creators remain unknown.

Precisely how such an edifice was produced and erected in this place, and by whom, is a topic of active study. Its age is believed to be approximately 6000 years, although evidence of even earlier activity exists at the site, resulting in ongoing 'discouragement and disruption tactics' against non-GATE researchers being carried out by its operatives stationed there.

Its purpose is theorized as solar observation and measurement, possibly connected to the geomagnetic maxima, which modelling suggests spikes dramatically every [REDACTED] years.

Compendium.Title: Temple of Stone
Compendium.Subtitle: Gorgon's Garden
SectionTexts:
A small and largely uninhabited Aegean island, surmounted by a temple to the goddess Athena at its eastern end.

The fate and state of the temple's inhabitants remains, at this stage, unexplained. Precise temporal positioning is also difficult to confirm, however celestial comparison data collected thus far strongly indicates this location represents GATE's first successful foray into Earth's own past, circa 2500 BCE.

Study is ongoing.

Compendium.Title: Alpen Signal Observatorium
Compendium.Subtitle: Dunkeltaler National Park
SectionTexts: Founded in Dunkeltaler, Switzerland in the early 1970s, the Alpen Signal Observatorium is an advanced astronomical research center. Inexplicably shuttered at the end of the 1980s, it reopened a few years later with reduced operations, and a single staff member at any one time. Its precise research goals have not been made public.

Compendium.Title: IS-0010
Compendium.Subtitle: Glowing Shard
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (HL/LC)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Personnel are advised not to stare directly at IS-0010 for extended periods during nocturnal hours.

Any staff researching or removing IS-0010 from containment must sign the release form stipulating the exact period of release.

Compendium.Title: IS-0013
Compendium.Subtitle: Tub of Blood
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (GW/AG/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: Containment for IS-0013 may not be opened between the hours of 7pm to 7am under any circumstances. This directive overrides any previous or current GISP protocols. Cleaning should be conducted daily to prevent risk of decay and build up of bio-fluids.

Compendium.Title: IS-0014
Compendium.Subtitle: Time Brake
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (IV/TL)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: It is essential to personnel safety that all research into IS-0014 remains non-contact until further notice.

Bringing any physical items or objects into close proximity with the subject is prohibited. Personal physical contact with the subject must not occur: observe a perimeter of at least 3ft from the subject at all times. Non-invasive or EM study is permitted, but appears almost entirely ineffective.

Compendium.Title: IS-0017
Compendium.Subtitle: Amnesia Threshold
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (LC/PY/EH)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: Access to IS-0017 is granted only by express permission of Immurement Manager, T. Enderson. Personnel granted access are forbidden to pass through IS-0017.

Any GATE staff determined to have breached these provisions will be subject to formal disciplinary proceedings, regardless of their mental state or recollection of events. Any investigation into the function of IS-0017 must conform with these protocols.

Recovered from a farmhouse on an island off the coast of Maine in 1986, it was rapidly realised that IS-0017 induced permanent amnesia in any who passed through it.

Excised and transported to the GATE Cascade Research Facility, it was further noted that the period of amnesiac experience varied with the speed of passage through the doorway, as well as the time of year.

The construction of the doorway has been identified as a type of teak endemic to Southern India, commonly used in boatbuilding.

The precise operation of IS-0017 remains a subject of active investigation.

Compendium.Title: IS-0018
Compendium.Subtitle: The Red Chair
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (CA/EH/GW)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: IS-0018 is to be kept in locked Crucis-level containment at all times. It may not be relocated, or its position shifted in any way without express permission of the GATE Executive Committee.

Research team staff may only approach IS-0018 when pursuing specific study objectives approved by the GATE Executive Committee.
