All such study is to be accompanied and monitored by a TransRecon unit of no fewer than four persons, equipped and armed according to manifest GCRF-ISP-0018A. Research team members must always be preceded by so-equipped TR team members if attempting to sit in the Red Chair.

Sitting, perching, lounging or loafing on or in the vicinity of IS-0018 is prohibited under all circumstances except those expressly provided for above.

Compendium.Title: IS-0023
Compendium.Subtitle: Darkwater Beast
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: As with all specimens from Anteverse 42, IS-0023 is predicted to outgrow the largest megaspecimen facilities currently available to GATE. While the final extent of the subject's growth is unknown, specimens exceeding 50m in length have been reliably reported by field researchers in A42.

GISP guidelines stipulate hydro-containment dimensions of at least 80x15m for specimens under 15m. All researchers must be accompanied by Gatekeepers or other staff trained in the defensive use of EM emission devices in the range of 100 eV to 100 keV.

Under no circumstances should IS-0023 be fed outside of the clearly defined weekly schedule.

Compendium.Title: IS-0028
Compendium.Subtitle: The Library
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Solutus (EX)

PROTOCOLS: While several putative modes of accession to IS-0028 have been theorized, current data provides no co-ordinates or points of entry.

Compendium.Title: IS-0031
Compendium.Subtitle: Unknown Location
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Thela (KV)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: IS-0031 is off-limits to all GATE personnel, unless accompanied by tactical TR teams equipped in accordance with manifest GCRF-ISP-0018A, including IR and low-light observation equipment, or approved Gatekeeper staff.

Hydrophobic protective wear is encouraged and, pursuant to GISP provisions, all returning persons must submit to full-spectrum decontamination until to further notice.

Compendium.Title: IS-0042
Compendium.Subtitle: The Lost Dog
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Solutus (IV/HL/LC)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: IS-0042 is to be hung on a wall measuring at least 2x2m. It can be viewed safely by GATE personnel, but no works of creative art are to be brought within 20 meters of the subject.

This includes, but is not limited to works executed in paint; hard materials; digital mediums; drawings; and any other format or media employed by any artist previously or now living regardless of whether the item in question has any perceived or agreed artistic merit or explicitly features or represents animals that may or may not resemble dogs.

Compendium.Title: IS-0052
Compendium.Subtitle: Gravity Dampener
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (HL/LC/R)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: IS-0052 must be kept clear of:

- gravitationally sensitive equipment
- temporally dynamic systems
- relativistic active research subjects
- all perforation events

Any staff handling IS-0052 are required to wear heavy impact protective clothing at all times.

Compendium.Title: IS-0053
Compendium.Subtitle: Kizz Cola Machine
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Jura (EN/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: IS-0053 is resistant to all known conventional containment systems and procedures. While no fatal incidents have been reported, GISP protocols advise 'moderate caution' when interacting with the subject. Immurement Management has deemed the entity low risk, but do not recommend ingesting any contents disgorged by IS-0053.

Compendium.Title: IS-0059
Compendium.Subtitle: [ REDACTED ]
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Solutus (AG/IN/IV)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: No known protocols or procedures for containing or impeding IS-0059 currently exist. The entity is able to enter and exit locations, including the Cascade Facility, seemingly at will. Factors influencing its arrival and departure remain speculative.

While high-energy electromagnetic energy appears to briefly halt or temporarily disperse IS-0059, conventional weapons systems used on the entity have had no notable effect.

It must be observed that any and all data garnered in relation to IS-0059 has been acquired under difficult or ad hoc circumstances. There have been no opportunities to study the subject under controlled conditions.

Compendium.Title: IS-0060
Compendium.Subtitle: Sector 13 Project
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Jura

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: All paperwork found from IS-0060 (paperwork referring to the "Sector 13 Project") is to be filed in a filing cabinet in the IS-0060 cell of Curie Wing and a Security Report must also be filed stating the full name and employee ID of the person who recovered the documents, when they first became aware of the documents, and where the documents were found.

Compendium.Title: IS-0064
Compendium.Subtitle: Composer
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/IV)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Effective containment of non-adjusted IS-0064 specimens requires the facility be located at least 2000m from any perforation phenomenon. All locations are to be equipped with perforation-suppressing fields, back-up power and fully hermetically sealed. Acoustic baffling is recommended, as the long term effects of exposure to the Composer's 'songs' are currently unknown.

Named for the haunting and thus far untranslated 'melodies' it emits while moving, the Composers appeared in Flathill directly after GATE's first successful perforation experiments, bringing with them the mists that now enshroud the town.

Subjects appear to be constrained in their territorial movement by geomagnetic and telluric currents endemic to the local area. This process is poorly understood at present. An alternate theory proposed by Dr. Abe Stern suggests that IS-0064’s exploration of the local area is limited by conditions in its home anteverse, which now obtrude in the vicinity of Flathill. Evidence for this possibility is still pending.

Compendium.Title: Flathill
Compendium.Subtitle:
GATE Crown Control Facility

Perforation Site Zero
SectionTexts:
The town of Flathill's position at the nexus of continent-wide telluric and geomagnetic currents made it the perfect place for GATE to commence its first perforation experiments.

Their first successful portal experiment took place in 1987, with a briefly stable connection to Anteverse 1.

Compendium.Title: IS-0083
Compendium.Subtitle: Space Queen
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (GW/EX/PY)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: IS-0083 is to be kept unpowered under Crucis containment protocols, except when being directly studied by Yellow Tier clearance staff and above.

The subject is only to be activated by TransRecon operatives fully trained in psycho-excursive protocols.

An extremely advanced 3D character action game, IS-0083 was recovered in 1987 from the storage basement of a defunct mall in Anaheim.

There is no official record of 'Space Queen' nor LycoSoft E.P.E., the company credited with creating it. Interviews with former mall staffers have resulted in no significant leads as to the origin of the unit itself.

Embedded in a video game arcade unit, IS-0083 is best described as a psycho-temporal gateway that transports the complete current awareness (CCA) of users to a simulated environment resembling a video game. The game story features a protagonist named Space Queen Maxine and her quest to reach the Orbital Oracle. The operation of the game is (optionally) two-player, with the second player being her 'trusty space feline'.

The origin or purpose of IS-0083 is unknown, and the exact nature and location of its operating system is likewise a subject of speculation by GATE researchers. Dr. Tengku has demonstrated, however, that the unit undergoes data loss and gain during operation.

Non-invasive tomography of the unit's interior aligns with a construction date circa 1982, however scans reveal componentry that is either generic or - like its extraordinarily advanced microprocessor and small-scale transistors - are stamped with markings that reference no known manufacturer. Further investigation would require disassembling - and possibly destroying - IS-0083, which at this time has not been permitted by Keystone.

Compendium.Title: IS-0091
Compendium.Subtitle: Leyak
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/AV)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: IS-0091 is to be subject at all times to an electromagnetic field with photon energies ranging from 100 eV to 100 keV - roughly coterminous with the x-ray spectrum. The subject must be identified hourly, and that observation recorded in the subject's daybook. Anyone viewing or perceiving IS-0091 under any other conditions should stare directly at the creature until it vanishes, then report the encounter IMMEDIATELY to Security staff.

A transcorporeal creature of uncertain origins, the 'Leyak' was discovered in Indonesia by a GATE TransRecon team led by Dr. Lenora Riggs.

The entity focuses its attention on a single person until observed for a given length of time, whereupon it vanishes, reappearing elsewhere and commencing its search again. IS-0091's only weakness appears to be high-energy EM, such as x-rays.

Compendium.Title: IS-0091-B
Compendium.Subtitle: Krasue
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/AV)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: All containment facilities for IS-0091-B must utilize vacuum-grade insulation and maintain temperatures at or below critical substantiation levels at all times.

Containment systems likewise require persistent high energy EM spectrum irradiation with a hardened, failsafe backup power connection.

As IS-0091-B is visible only to its target at any given time, approved study must be conducted by a single, designated researcher. In the event of containment breach or failure, the active researcher is directed to maintain direct line of visual contact until IS-0091-B desubstantiates, then notify Gatekeeper personnel immediately. 

Grade 4 low-temperature protective clothing is mandated for all personnel entering IS-0091-B containment.

Although IS-0091-B exhibits behaviors akin to its phylogenetic cousin, such as only appearing initially to single viewers, the entity has many divergent characteristics. 

IS-0091-B is an extremophile theorized to originate in a frigid environment, and its presence has been observed to significantly affect temperature gradients in the immediate vicinity

Like IS-0091-A, direct attention will cause the subject to disperse. The entity is also more resistant to a higher range of EM energies than IS-0091-A, requiring frequencies above 100KeV to desubstantiate.

Compendium.Title: IS-0092
Compendium.Subtitle: The Lodestones
SectionTexts:
While little is know about the origins of these so-called 'Lodestones', or how many exist on Earth or elsewhere, there is one key property that is undeniable: these artefacts attract perforation exits.

Akin to a pin stuck in a map, the device seems crafted to allow its creators to swiftly open portals to any co-ordinates where a Lodestone was present.

The fact that this behavior extends across not just space, but also time, indicates intimidatingly advanced capabilities on the part of its designers.

A question still lingers regarding the symbols and shapes etched into its surface. Some found on Earth appear highly anthropocentric, while those from elsewhere feel distinctly alien. Whether this indicates origin or intent, or perhaps multiple creators, is uncertain.

Compendium.Title: IS-0093
Compendium.Subtitle: Belief Virus
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (IF/PY)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: IS-0093 may be stored under conventional pathogenic or infectious biohazard protocols. However, only those researchers who refuse to acknowledge its existence are permitted access to its containment cell.

Staff must be carefully vetted for belief, and any who accept the reality of this micro-organism are to prevented from working on, studying or otherwise investigating IS-0093.

Compendium.Title: IS-0094
Compendium.Subtitle: The Creeping Crystal
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (EN/HL/IN/PS)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: IS-0094 must be connected to a dedicated 'harvesting' system managed by a regularly-serviced control system. This system and all peripherals must be connected to fail-safe backup power. In the event of extended electrical failure, IS-0094 is to be incinerated after no-more than 36 hours. Under no circumstances is IS-0094 allowed contact with any other entity or artefact from Anteverse 17.

Compendium.Title: IS-0099
Compendium.Subtitle: Antique Shotgun
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (EH/LC/PS)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Observe storage protocols for IS-0099 as with any conventional firearm: separate the subject from easily accessed ammunition; always treat the subject as if was loaded; do not point it at anyone; oil and clean it regularly; and test-fire carefully wearing ear and vision protection. 

Additionally, when test-firing IS-0099 ensure no personnel are present within a 50m radius and no valuable or sensitive machinery, stores, equipment, weaponry, infrastructure, architecture or structurally significant material is present within a 30° arc extending 2500m downrange.

Compendium.Title: IS-0101
Compendium.Subtitle: The Sun Disk
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (EN/EH/TL) [THEORIZED]

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Unconfirmed

The first reports of IS-0101 surfaced in late 1987, after an object of extraordinary brightness appeared briefly in High Earth Orbit.

Although no GATE staff member has direct experience with this artefact, its dimensions appear to precisely match the 1977 Voyager space probe's Golden Record - prompting Dr. A. Cahn to theorize that it is an extra-terrestrial response to humanity's attempt at outreach.

The brief readings attained at the time of its appearance indicate it may be crafted from raw stellar matter.

Little is known for sure about the artifact's fate, which disappeared less than 24 hours after being identified. Subsequent reports point strongly to it being in possession of the Order, although how they retrieved it so rapidly, or contained it effectively, remains the subject of speculation. Whether they have extracted coherent information from IS-0101, or have even attempted this, is likewise uncertain.

While the contents of the Sun Disk's message remain obscure, it is clear that contact with the artefact alleviates some of the more instantly lethal effects of extreme conditions.

This suggests the device may, amongst other things, be intended to encourage communication - or even contact - between beings habituated to drastically different surviveable temperatures.

Compendium.Title: IS-0102
Compendium.Subtitle: The Love Potion
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Thela (EH/IF/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: IS-0102 is to be stored under extreme infectious pathogen protocols, in secure containment within a fully hermetic outer housing. This housing must be flooded with hyper-pressurized, non-expanding flammable gas within 2.5 seconds of an alert with complete ignition and burn complete within 10 seconds.

All researchers must wear complete biohazard protection with independent air systems. Security personnel must be present during all live investigations. In the advent of exposure to the pathogen by any member of staff, security personnel are to prevent those exposed from leaving containment. Live fire is authorized.

Compendium.Title: IS-0105
Compendium.Subtitle: The Snow Globe
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Jura (AV/GW/R)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: IS-0105 must be kept at all times in a physically decoupled Crucis-level containment zone, isolated from all sources of motion, drift or residual momentum.

The item should only be touched or, under extreme circumstances, moved by approved TransRecon operatives equipped for long-term field deployment and cold weather survival.

Compendium.Title: IS-0107
Compendium.Subtitle: The Time Bomb
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION:Thela (AG/IV/TL)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: None.

First documented in Djenne, Mali, in 200 B.C., the so-called Time Bomb was discovered in 1933 to be growing at a rate of approximately 0.1% per year. Current theories believe that it was a weapon, designed to destroy the universe, however it was deployed by an aggressor from Anteverse 12 who miscalculated the relative differences in time speed between our universes. 

In roughly 40,000 years this indestructible device will be large enough to pose a threat to our galaxy. As such, GATE launched the unit into space in 1985, trusting that, by this time, humanity will have discovered a way to return the weapon to its creator, or destroy it. Failing that, it will, at least, be considerably further away.

Compendium.Title: IS-0111
Compendium.Subtitle: The Minder
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (HL/LC/R)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: All personnel in regular contact with IS-0111 must maintain a daily 'mood log' well as undertake weekly psychometric benchmarking.

Do not place hands near IS-0111's feeding aperture, and avoid making high-pitched, purring or buzzing noises within 12ft or less of the subject.

Compendium.Title: IS-0117
Compendium.Subtitle: The Wayseeker
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Jura (AV/AG/CA/EH/EN/IN/PY)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: Unknown
When the rift cusp is severed as the Wayseeker passes through, yet not permitted to collapse, it shall be stranded - Pyre

Compendium.Title: IS-0121
Compendium.Subtitle: Tarasque
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Containment facilities for IS-0121, like all non-aquatic specimens originating from Anteverse 42, require extensive material hardening.

For design and construction specifications, refer to GATE Megaspecimen and Holocaust Protection Manual (1.6.4.7). Only one IS-0121 specimen is to be contained per site and no gaseous exchange of more than 5ppm permitted between any two sites. Structural mass dampeners are suggested but not, at this stage, an essential requirement.

The Tarasque's circulatory fluid has exceptional capacitation properties. This 'ichor' is currently being investigated by Dr. Theodore Laciter for its ability to store and rapidly discharge very high quantities of energy, particularly as it relates to the power demands of instigating perforation events.

Due to an immense disjunction in scale, the Tarasque - like IS-0023 - is a near-microscopic entity in its home of Anteverse 42, but a giant in A0, and continuing to grow. The full extent of its growth is not yet known.

A variant - IS-0121-B or the Behemoth - was observed, and later recovered, from Anteverse XLII by the Requited. While distinct in patterning, the entity likewise shows no signs of slowing its growth.

Compendium.Title: IS-0122
Compendium.Subtitle: Shadowhopper
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Thela (AV/AG/EH)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: At all times when IS-0122 is not being directly studied, the subject is to be kept in total darkness.

Containment sites are required to be entirely unadorned with no decoration, furniture or excresences of any kind. Spheroid construction is a known risk-reducing factor. All walls, floors and ceilings should be polished to a micro-topographical variance of no more than 500 microns.

During phases of research, ensure all containment sites for the entity are lit with a diffuse illumination of less than 5 watts per square radian. Avoid all direct lighting or any other shadow-casting sources. All personnel must wear mouth and nose coverings, as well as one-piece seamless body wear.

Compendium.Title: IS-0127
Compendium.Subtitle: The Snowman
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/CA/PY)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: IS-0127 must be stored in a hermetically sealed environment away from any and all sources of moisture, at a temperature of 2° C, varying by no more than 0.5° C.

If contained in proximity to a target, the target must be stored at 0° C or lower. Under no circumstances should IS-0127 ever be brought within 100cm of the central 'face' region of a target. Further, researchers are advised to keep IS-0127 away from all human or humanoid faces generally.

In the event of IS-0127 successfully unifying with a target, containment of the activated entity should only be undertaken by armed Gatekeeper staff.

Research personnel are to be aware that the entity appears to treat children under 12 years of age with an entirely separate personality, and exhibits none of the hostility markers seen when engaging with older children or adults.

IS-0127 is, at first glance, little more than a particularly unappetizing carrot. However, analysis by GATE scientists indicates a complex crystalline matrix within, hinting at a dense informational structure - a fact believed to account for its unusual weight. 

During field study in Anteverse 188, TransRecon Team 4 conjoined IS-0127 to the cranial area of a 2.7 meter tall frozen humanoid form consisting of three spheres tapering upwards, followed by a brief adjustment of the headwear sitting atop the configuration. A rapid physical transformation began to occur before the entity was 'aggressively withdrawn' by Gatekeeper Aspen attached to TR 4.

The resulting specimen was transported to the Cascade Research Facility and held in cold storage. It is strongly believed that this 'icy incunabulum' (in the words of Dr. Daria Kale) represents a transitional phase in an unsettling - and potentially lethal - metamorphisis.

Compendium.Title: IS-0128-A
Compendium.Subtitle: The Skink
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: A previously identified, albeit unstudied entity from Anteverse 21, IS-0128 appears to be an extremophile organism with an affinity for radioactive environs.

Immurement protocols for this entity have not yet been promulgated, but high-strength netting with electrical discharge appears to effectively contain IS-0128 for a short duration. After successive shocks, the creature can be picked up safely. Regardless, staff are advised to avoid the creature's acidic regurgitation at all costs.

Compendium.Title: IS-0128-B
Compendium.Subtitle: Magma Skink
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/EH)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Auxiliary precautions above and beyond those required for safe containment of IS-0128-B's precursor are currently being assessed. Like those for IS-0173-H, construction recommendations under review include techniques borrowed from industrial steel manufacturing, and in the specific case of IS-0128-B, high temperature plasma storage.

Compendium.Title: IS-0128-C
Compendium.Subtitle: Verdant Skink
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: IS-0128-C is subject to similar containment precautions as IS-0128-A and -B, but restrictions on research access are less stringent.

Although personnel working in proximity of this entity should avoid sudden or startling movements, the addition of low dosage aspirated fluoxetine to the containment air supply has shown a significant reduction in IS-0128-C incidents. Personnel are, however, cautioned to watch for a sense of wellness, healthful feelings, or general well-being. Anyone suffering these symptoms should exit the immediate vicinity of IS-0128-C immediately.

All staff attempting to study or interact with IS-0128-C should ensure their clothing or protective wear is machine washable.

Compendium.Title: IS-0134-A
Compendium.Subtitle: Yeti
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/CA)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: IS-0134 requires standard megaspecimen containment, including extensive material hardening, structual reinforcement and impact bracing.

Overhead clearance of a minimum 5m is also required, due to the subject's athletic proclivities. Once immured, however, IS-0134's reclusive instincts lead it to be relatively docile unless disturbed.

In terms of habitat, IS-0134 requires a temperature-controlled environment, maintained at less than -2 degrees Celcius. Extremely susceptible to high temperatures, the subject must be kept away from any and all naked flames, given the exceptionally flammable quality of its fur.

Compendium.Title: IS-0138
Compendium.Subtitle: The Train - Anteverse 11
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Thela (EH/EN/R)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: A recursive, superpositioned meta-location, IS-0138 is theorized to be held together at the atomic level by the Train's ongoing momentum. Although untested, mathematical modelling suggests that if the train were to stop, the energy released would be 10 to power 55 joules.

While the precise origins, intention, and purpose of IS-0138 remain a mystery, GATE trans-kinematic researchers have determined that the train's super positional state entails a singular fact: cessation of its momentum would release sufficient energy into the local time-space continuum to tear a hole from here to the Eagle Nebula.

As to why this 19th Century relic exists, how it came to contain authentic Gorham silverware, or what lies beyond the seemingly infinite grasslands it speeds through, GATE is yet to discover.

Compendium.Title: IS-0139
Compendium.Subtitle: [ REDACTED ]
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/CA/IF)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Standards for the safe immurement of IS-0139 subjects are currently under assessment by GISE. The following are provisional and do not constitute official GISP standards:

- Full viral and pathogenic biohazard containment
- Electrical insulation rated to 2MV
- Motion-triggered IR monitoring
- Grade 2 blast dampening

An extremely evasive entity, the as-yet-unnamed IS-0139 is a crystalline creature capable of refracting visible light to camouflage itself. Research into its biology has proven challenging, due to its propensity to explode into shards under stress.

Compendium.Title: IS-0142
Compendium.Subtitle: Reservoir Growth
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Pending.

According to the official incident report, a fragment of IS-0142 was accidentally dropped into the Cascade Reservoir during transport to containment. Due to inaccuate inventory processes, this was only determined several weeks after the fact. By this time the organism had already grown over an extensive region of the reservoir. All subsequent efforts to eradicate IS-0142 have proven fultile.

Originating in Anteverse XIII, IS-0142 has been theorized by Dr. Wakeman to be a biomechanical computation device of considerable sophistication, and possibly an artificial lifeform in its own right. The subject eludes easy categorization, and confirmatory research is pending. The subject is provisionally designated Sanc.

Observers of the entity note that its activity appears to be intensifying at the center of the reservoir. Further, the glowworms endemic to the area seem to congregate directly above this point.

Compendium.Title: IS-0154
Compendium.Subtitle: The Residue
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (LC/R)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: Although designated an Immured Subject, IS-0154 is fundamentally self-contained.

Appearing after Gatekeepers installed an aura lock on the 'migratory' Intrados facility, IS-0154 is regarded as a highly radioactive residue of this area's time spent lost in a perforational limbo.

Detached from time as we perceive it, the anomalies are stranded between our dimension and a theoretical infinity of others, grounding in no specific reality... Or so remains the leading theory.

Compendium.Title: IS-0155-A
Compendium.Subtitle: Entropy Flower
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: (EN/LC/PS)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: All instances of IS-0155-A are to be monitored weekly for new growth. Any new growth exceeding 30 inches is to be removed and disposed of via incineration. The ashes are to be sifted for remains, left to sit for no less than 20 days, before being removed to a secure disposal site in keeping with the GISP provisions.

Compendium.Title: IS-0166
Compendium.Subtitle: The Paperweight
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Jura (HL/R)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Store IS-0166 upright at all times. Keep the subject away from sensitive or high-energy equipment until further notice. 

Monitor all exposed staff for compulsions to sketch, etch or otherwise represent IS-0166.

Compendium.Title: IS-0169
Compendium.Subtitle: The Fragment
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (R)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: IS-0169 must be fixed or held in place at all times, connected to a centrally monitored alarm system that registers any lapse of contact with the restraint mechanisms.

Ensure containment doors remain closed when cell unoccupied. Recommended dimensions of containment: no larger than 3x3m.

Recovered from a cave in rural Exmoor, England, IS-0169 cannot be marked or damage in any way. Essentially massless, it moves with near zero inertia, lacking any kind of space time presence.

Presumably a fragment of some larger object, GATE currently has no actual or theoretical framework for this item.

Compendium.Title: IS-0171-A
Compendium.Subtitle: Carbuncle
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (AG/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: IS-0171-A is to be isolated by a perimeter cordon with a radius of 12ft or greater at all times. No personnel may approach within 10ft unless wearing full face and body protective wear conforming to GISP bio-protective standards at all times. Full decontamination required on all equipment exposed to IS-0171-A.

Originating in Anteverse 2 IS-0171 is a stationary, sessile entity that traps its food with a retractable tentacle. Although highly aggressive, the creature is more of an encumbrance than a threat to larger prey.

Compendium.Title: IS-0171-B
Compendium.Subtitle: Mushroom Carbuncle
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (AG/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: All storage locations for IS-0171-B must be fully hermetically sealed and all research personnel interacting with live subjects must wear micro-grade, corrosion resistant oxygen filters at all times. All equipment must be irradiated and decontaminated in accordance with GISP anti-hyphatic procedures.

A variant of IS-0171 endemic to the Mycofields of Anteverse 2, the Mushroom Carbuncle ejects a plume of toxic spores when approached. While the exact factors contributing to the creature's evolution are unclear, Dr. Petra Peters is pursuing research into the epigenetic effects of spore exposure. The creature also produces a fungus that is edible by humans when cooked.

Compendium.Title: IS-0172
Compendium.Subtitle: Pre-Human Artefact
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Ordo (HL/PS)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: General Ordo storage protocols apply (see GISP 3.2).

Although there are no known risks currently associated with IS-0172, its extraordinary and inexplicable ancience entails the possibility of as-yet unknown behaviors or qualities. However, nothing has come to light through full-spectrum nor Magnetic Resonance Imaging.

T. R. Enderson noted that the artifact's immurement designation requires review and possibly elevation to a memetic hazard, if only for the urgency of the questions it raises about the human historical record and the potential effect of that knowledge on the general population.

Compendium.Title: IS-0173-A
Compendium.Subtitle: Pest
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (AG/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: IS-0173-A is to be separated from researchers by barriers a minimum of 8ft in height at all times, unless subject is sedated or dead. Acoustic baffling is suggested for all containment environments and loud noises or use of power equipment is strongly discouraged. Subject is to be fed remotely.

Small and omnivorous, IS-0173-A is an aggressive monopod that attacks its prey with a highly extensible tongue.

While it is clearly a sub-species of similar specimens, IS-0173-A also shows a degree of morphic continuity with other Anteverse 2 creatures such as IS-0171 and IS-0178.

Compendium.Title: IS-0173-B
Compendium.Subtitle: Electro-Pest
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (AG/IN) 

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: All specimens of IS-0173-B should be kept in non-metallic environments at all times and must be kept fully electrically isolated using containers lined with non-conductive rubber padding. Observe all other containment provisions belonging to IS-0173-A, noting that any interaction with the subject, even sedated, must be performed with all equipment fully electrically grounded.

The electric variant of IS-0173-A was a cybernetic experiment proposed by Dr. Abraham Stern. Although rapid progress was made towards a viable organism, Dr. Derek Manse ordered work suspended in favor of investigations into the creature's hypertrophied evolution. The program has been in hiatus since late 1992.

Compendium.Title: IS-0173-C
Compendium.Subtitle: Volatile Pest
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/IN/EN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: Methods for approaching or studying IS-0173-C and other entities affected by 'volatile' phenomena are currently under investigation. The following provisional immurement standards are recommended:

- Full viral and pathogenic biohazard containment, including corrosion resistant oxygen filters at all times.
- Full body blast-resistant personal shielding.
- Eyes and skin must remain covered at all times.
- All storage sites should employ radiation shielding and grade 3 blast dampening.
- All equipment must be irradiated in accordance with GISP decontamination procedures.

Compendium.Title: IS-0173-D
Compendium.Subtitle: Carbonated Pest
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: IS-0173-D is to be contained under similar conditions to IS-0173-A, but any sedatives administered for the purpose of study must be non-eructative. Subject is to be fed remotely on a diet devoid of complex sugars, carbonated beverages, dairy products, legumes and all vegetables from the brassica or allium families.

Compendium.Title: IS-0173-E
Compendium.Subtitle: Rattus Pestis
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Immurement precautions for this entity should observe standard IS-0173 variant protocols with the following considerations:
- Atmospheric provision should include a regular micro-infusion of corticosteriod
- Researchers are required to empty all pockets, containers and bags before entering IS-0173-E containment.
- No personal effects are permitted within 5 meters of the entity.

Compendium.Title: IS-0173-F
Compendium.Subtitle: Enlightened Pest
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/PY)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: All sites charged with holding IS-0173-F specimens must observe basic IS-0173-A protocols, and the following supplemental precautions:
- Researchers are required to engage in 20 minutes of GATE-approved meditation activity before entering IS-0173-D containment
- The following minerals are not permitted within 30 meters of IS-0173-F: Black Tourmaline, Hematite, Jasper
- Avoid negative visualization, anxious distraction or prayer

Compendium.Title: IS-0173-H
Compendium.Subtitle: Magma Pest
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/EH)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: In addition to the precautions recommended for any IS-0173 variant, all containment structures for IS-0173-H require a ceramic refractory coating on internal surfaces. Material construction standards are currently under review, but equivalent to or higher than an electric arc furnace. All flammable materials are expressly forbidden within IS-0173-H containment.

Compendium.Title: IS-0173-I
Compendium.Subtitle: Snow Pest
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/CA)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: While IS-0173-I requires no further containment procedures beyond those stipulated for all IS-0173 variants, researchers with access to heated protective wear are recommended to wear these whether the subject is conscious or not. These include battery-heated outer shell garments, cold-weather sportswear and, on at least one occasion, an EVA suit.

Compendium.Title: IS-0173-L
Compendium.Subtitle: Leyak Pest
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Thela (AG/AV)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: In the aftermath of events at [DATA REDACTED], new standards for containing IS-0173-L were instituted under GISP 3.2.

Basic IS-0173 and IS-0091 containment protocols continue to be essential, but all IS-0173-L entities are deemed to require the following attendant precautions:

- Full prismatic 'Scarecrow' apprehension apparatus for all researchers engaged in any visual assessment of IS-0173-L
- A complete prohibition on gamelan music or performances featuring such instruments within 300 meters.

Compendium.Title: IS-0177
Compendium.Subtitle: The Perforations
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Jura (EX/GW/IN/IV/R)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: None.

First sighted in Jerusalem in 1 BCE, but theorized to have occurred much earlier, GATE has no current measures to counteract or contain these external perforation events.

These perforations have been shown to involve coherent data transfer, leading investigators to believe they are preliminary attempts to survey or possibly enter our world.

Suspected purposes include communication, resource extraction, colonization.

More study required.

Compendium.Title: IS-0178-A
Compendium.Subtitle: Peccary
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/IN/PY)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: Any containment space for IS-0178-A specimens must measure no more than 3x3m square, ensuring the subject is unable to attain a velocity greater than 5m/s.

All walls and flooring should be reinforced to GISP standards for blast shielding and be electrically grounded to 2MV. Subjects must be contained separately, and fed remotely.

Colloquially dubbed a 'Peccary', IS-0178 is a quadrupedal predator that uses psionic energy to hunt its prey. 

Preliminary research suggests that these abilities are much 'higher wattage' here in our own universe, where energy concentrations are comparatively higher, than the severely entropic Anteverse II, which is its home.

Compendium.Title: IS-0178-B
Compendium.Subtitle: Mushroom Peccary
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (AG/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: All storage sites for IS-0178-B must be cleaned to a sterility standard equal to or above GISP minimums for viral and pathogenic containment. Daily checks for mycelium spread must be implemented, and any spores, growths or blooms immediately removed.

As with its clade-member IS-0178-A, all walls and flooring should be reinforced to GISP standards. Feed remotely.

Compendium.Title: IS-0178-C
Compendium.Subtitle: Tareccary
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Thela (AG/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Precautions for containing IS-0178-C are similar to those for it its progenitor, but require higher grade reinforcement to withstand the creature's increased strength and immense physical resilience.

A by-product of the Jotun programme, this entity was initially treated as a curious miscegenation, rather than a subject of serious study because of its low intelligence and extreme belligerence.

Compendium.Title: IS-0178-D
Compendium.Subtitle: Electro-Peccary
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Thela (AG/EH)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Combining general precautions for IS-0178 variants, and specific provisions for IS-0173-B, containment structures for IS-0178-D require:

- Entirely non-metallic environmental construction and full electric insulation on all surfaces
- All study equipment, tools and protective clothing to be electrically grounded to a 2MV rating
- A total containment area of no more than 3x3m square preventing entity velocities higher than 5m/s
- GISP-standard blast shielding on all walls, doors and floors

Further, acoustic baffling is recommended as IS-0178-D is highly reactive to sound in the 10Hz-30kHz range.

Compendium.Title: IS-0178-E
Compendium.Subtitle: Alpha Peccary
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Thela (AG/PY)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: While basic IS-0178 variant containment is acceptable for IS-0178-E, some researchers have argued that its increased size demands containment larger than 3x3m. The case for 'ethical' IS containment remains a relatively new and contentious trend within GATE study frameworks.

Compendium.Title: IS-0178-F
Compendium.Subtitle: Peccary Sow
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/EN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: According to GISP 3.2 provisions, conventional IS-0178 containment design is sufficient for IS-0178-F. However researchers must observe the following personal precautions in the presence of the entity:

- Any attempt to extract or otherwise harvest bodily fluids from IS-0178-F should only be conducted when the subject has been exposed to approved pheromonic suppressants
- Do not attempt to imbibe fluids from IS-0178-F under any circumstances

Compendium.Title: IS-0178-G
Compendium.Subtitle: Volatile Peccary
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/EH)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Enhanced by the entropic delta between Anteverse 2 and our own, IS-0178-G's exceptional aggression and speed render any attempt to research conscious specimens impossible.

This entity is to be kept permanently sedated under full IS-0178 containment by the order of the GATE Executive Committee. Research areas are to be covered with anti-corrosive coatings, and all personnel must observe full decontamination after exposure.

Compendium.Title: IS-0178-H
Compendium.Subtitle: Snow Peccary
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: A recent discovery, no specimen of IS-0178-H has yet been induced or captured. Containment requirements remain unknown.

Compendium.Title: IS-0184-A
Compendium.Subtitle: Exor
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/EN/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: All containment facilities for IS-0184-A require Grade 4 impact shielding and/or Grade 5 blast dampening in accordance with GISP ratings. All personnel conducting research on this subject must wear Grade 4 body armor with full electrical grounding, even when subject is sedated or unconscious. Direct interaction in any state is not advised.

IS-0184-A should not be exposed to any flammable materials. Feed remotely.
A bipedal hunter with a sophisticated bio-electric defence adaptation, the Exor was first discovered in 1987 by Dr. Lenora Riggs.

Compendium.Title: IS-0184-B
Compendium.Subtitle: Exor Monk
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/GW/IN/R)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: All IS-0184-B subjects require heavy shielding and perforation-suppressing containment. All immurement sites must avoid geomagnetically and tellurically active locations.

Fail-safe connection to back-up power is required at all times, as even a micro-lapse in suppression fields risks containment failure. The subject cannot be approached unless sedated, and should be fed remotely.

IS-0184B is a near relation of IS-0184A, with some notable differences.

Able to generate a short-distance perforation using internal bioelectrical energy, specimens recovered from Anteverse 2 often display crafted decorations, indicating tool-making technology.

Further study is urgently required.
The creature's organs retain notable quantum properties when removed from its body.

Compendium.Title: IS-0184-C
Compendium.Subtitle: Armored Exor
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: All IS-0184C containment sites must employ Grade 5 impact shielding, heavy blast dampening and electrical grounding rated to 2MW, with full acoustic baffling and an approved one-way accession portal.

However, the combination of heavy chitnous armor, bioelectrical tracking projectiles and ultrasonic vocalizations has, in practice, meant that anything less than permanent sedation of IS-0184C carries considerable risk of injury or death to assigned researchers.

The subject is the most aggressive and destructive known variant of IS-0184A and IS-0184B, and provides further evidence for a growing weight of GATE research that indicates the intervention of an external agent in the evoution of this lifeform.

Compendium.Title: IS-0184-D
Compendium.Subtitle: Exor Cha
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/GW/IN/R)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: IS-0184-D must be kept in geomagnetically isolated conditions with permanent, fail-safe connection to back-up power. Full-spectrum perforation-suppressive measures must be observed at all times within 20 meters of the entity, as with the closely related IS-0184-B.

Further, IS-0184-D must not be permitted near sticks, branches, short poles, pikes, long-handled tools or any implement it might use as a weapon.

Compendium.Title: IS-0184-E
Compendium.Subtitle: Volatile Exor
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/EN/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: Full assessment of IS-0184-E immurement protocols: pending.

The origin of 0184-E's transformation is presumed to lie in fungal pathogens spread from Anteverse 2. These pathogens have themselves undergone significant mutation since prolifertating through Mist Reactor and beyond. Staff are advised that previous safety directives may be no longer be reliable. 

Any personnel interacting with 0184-E should wear complete radiological and fungal protection at all times. However, any encounter with IS-0184-E under anything less than full physical restraint, total sedation and/or complete discontinuation of life signs is highly discouraged to prevent irrevocable harm to researchers.

Provisional storage protocols for this entity stipulate Grade 2 concrete-reinforced radiation shielding for all sites, and extremely small containment spaces to limit the entities achievable kinetic velocity.

Compendium.Title: Anteverse 2A
Compendium.Subtitle: Far Garden
SectionTexts: In accordance with trans-luminal modelling, GATE’s second perforation experiment ‘grounded’ itself in one of the largest bodies of mass in Anteverse 2 – its unfathomably old heart.

Compendium.Title: Anteverse 2B
Compendium.Subtitle: The Mycofields
SectionTexts:
Craggy and malformed, this region of Anteverse 2 is little more than a mass of rock orbiting a ‘sun’ that is no sun at all - rather a vacuum point slowly sucking everything towards it.

Much closer to it's 'star' than Anteverse 2A, the tidal forces generate tremendous heat, producing tributaries of superheated magma that restrict the growth of endemic vegetation, already limited by the realm's direly low entropy.

A jagged maze of caves, cliffs, ledges and ancient paths, existence under these conditions is extremely harsh and competition for resources is brutally intense. The creatures that live within it are forced to adapt to - and exploit - the profusion of fungal life that persists there.

Compendium.Title: Anteverse 2C
Compendium.Subtitle: Village Den da'ko Yeer
SectionTexts:
Grouped around an object of unknown provenance, the Exor settlement displays clear signs of design and craftsmanship, indicating more clearly than ever that - at least some of - IS-0178 and its many variants possess intelligence.

The artifact at its core remains an obdurate mystery, although several TransRecon members have noted that it appears to be venerated by the Exor that surround it.

Compendium.Title: IS-0211
Compendium.Subtitle: Power Leech
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Solutus (EN/EX/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: All previous attempts at containing this denizen of Anteverse 23 have proved fruitless, and little practical research has been accomplished - or even made possible.

Observations have shown IS-0211 has been able to unmoor itself from physical space, resulting in even more evasive behavior than IS-0139.

Commenting on the two creatures' apparently similar crystalline morphology, Dr. Peters offered two possible theories. The first suggests potentially parallel evolutionary tracks, although she notes that behavioral similarities are largely superficial.

Dr. Peters favors her second theory, which proposes that both subjects are infected with an extremely aggressive, and as-yet unidentified pathogen that drastically transforms their physiology, drawing into question the nature of Anteverse 23 and its apparent crystalline inclination.

Compendium.Title: IS-0223
Compendium.Subtitle: The Coworker
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (AV/AG/CA)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: All staff are directed to treat IS-0223, if encountered, as a legitmate employee. Do not question or interrogate the subject. Provide with food if requested.

Compendium.Title: IS-0235
Compendium.Subtitle: Tape Wisp
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Solutus (EN/IN/CA)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Under no circumstances is the tape containing IS-0235 to be brought into contact with a video cassette recorder. It must not be played, viewed or displayed. The subject is to be considered contained until further notice.

Compendium.Title: IS-0247
Compendium.Subtitle: The Moving Box
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (AV/HL/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: Attempts to contain or confine IS-0247 have been unsuccessful to date. While conventional architecture may restrict the entity's movement for hours at a time, it will eventually remove itself even from Jura-level containment locations. No known perforation-dampening systems have impeded its movements.

Hypothesized to be an artificial creation, IS-0247 has a noted tendency to accompany and mimic certain upright bipedal organisms. It was first identified in the GATE Cascade Research Facility following the original Transrecon expedition to Anteverse 1, appearing to have followed the TR team home.

The entity will store items placed within it for an indefinite period. Its inner storage capacity is known to exceed its outer dimensions, suggesting non-Euclidean internal workings. While this has the potential for utility, the irregularity of IS-0247's appearances is a limiting factor.

Compendium.Title: IS-0255
Compendium.Subtitle: Bigfoot
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/CA)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: IS-0255 is subject to standard megaspecimen containment. Extreme caution must be taken to restrict its access to any objects or items that could be used to fashion tools or rudimentary escape tools, including but not limited to cleaning equipment, dishes, wire and screws, or metallic objects generally.

Further, all personnel undertaking direct study of IS-0255 are required to leave all photographic and recording equipment outside, as the presence of such devices can induce violent agitation.

Compendium.Title: IS-0299
Compendium.Subtitle: Nocturnal Anomaly
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (EN/IN/TL)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: Pending.

Compendium.Title: IS-0307-A
Compendium.Subtitle: The Game Sprite
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Containment procedures for IS-0307 are part of an ongoing investigation led by Dr. Stern.

While entirely effective containment protocols are not yet established, electromagnetic insulation and Faraday shielding is known to retard IS-0307's movement. When entering or egressing from such containment spaces, full spectrum EM-jamming equipment must be in operation.

Any digital device, mechanism or hardware known to contain IS-0307 must be kept at least 40ft from unhardened video or digital equipment.

IS-0307 is currently contained within IS-0083, which Dr. Stern has argued was infected via an osmotic electromagnetic process originating from IS-0235's near-proximity containment cell.

Although research staff are not yet certain as to the precise mechanics of this colonization, IS-0307 appears to have begun its lifecycle in IS-0235, then mutated as it migrated to the nearby, unprotected digital environment of IS-0083.

In the process, IS-0307 has infected the game's control systems, propagating itself through several independent entities or, as Dr. Stern theorizes, a singular entity with multiple instances: the so-called Lamogi and Bombogi of 'Space Queen'. In so doing, it has increased the apparent aggression of these pre-existing game enemies, and eradicated much of the endemic 'life' of the simulation, the remainder of which appear to have also been compromised or otherwise influenced by the infection. The symptoms of this infection are of much interest and require further study.

The exact demarcation between IS-0235 and IS-0307 remains contentious.

Compendium.Title: IS-0307-B
Compendium.Subtitle: Speedogi
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: A subject of active research, IS-0307-B's securement procedures remain under advisement. However, in addition to recommended protocols for IS-0307-A, suggested precautions include:

- Ensure containment volumes for IS-0307-B subjects are separated by at least 100ft from all EN, GW or IF subjects
- Limit containment volume to 6x6ft to impede movement

Contrary to earlier suppositions, IS-0307 variants are now believed to have reacted to a bosonic organism introduced to IS-0083. Although the manner of infection is not yet understood, the suspected vector is IS-0235, which was contained in an adjacent cell.

Compendium.Title: IS-0307-C
Compendium.Subtitle: Sir Ogi
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Crucis (AG/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Although official precautions for securing IS-0307-C are still being formulated, GATE's draft recommendations include baseline IS-0307 protocols, and additionally:

- Structural hardening of walls, floors, doors, and any architectural features within 3ft of the ground
- Isolation from strong magnetic fields
- Regular lubrication

Like IS-0307-A and -B variants, the subject is suspected of being a vector for an aggressive pathogen (see IS-0083 and IS-0235), which is transmitted by means as-yet unknown. All IS-0307-C subjects should be contained at least 100ft from any EN, GW or IF entities, and treated by Level 3 GISP pathogenic and infectious biohazard protocols.

Compendium.Title: IS-0333
Compendium.Subtitle: Space Lettuce
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Ordo (EN/HL)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: General Ordo storage protocols apply (see GISP).

Compendium.Title: IS-0407
Compendium.Subtitle: Symphonist
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Thela (AG/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: Rarely observed and largely undocumented, IS-0407 has no known containment procedures at this time.

TR reports remain inconclusive, but suggest an entity that is largely or entirely sightless, with morphic similarities to IS-0064. Although attendant meteorological conditions have impeded observation during its few alleged encounters, reports note its bedraggled, contorted form.

Compendium.Title: IS-0413
Compendium.Subtitle: Perforation Bees
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (AG/IN)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: Containment of a single swarm of IS-0413 can be effected by placing a mature Queen in a standard beehive-like housing. No further contact should be made with IS-0413, nor should any action be undertaken to agitate IS-0413 without adequate personal protection.

High-nutrient liquid sources nearby must be refilled routinely to avoid migration of the hive colony, which must also be well-separated from any other instance of IS-0413.

Under these conditions, a honey-like substance may be regularly extracted from the hive. Testing indicates this high-viscosity (~2700 cps) liquid is safe for consumption, but studies into its effects and nutritional value are ongoing.

The origin of IS-0413 is currently unknown, but the parallels with local evolution are under active research. Superficially similar to bees, the creatures naturally create a hive-like, fractal structure which they inhabit en masse. An additional note has been recorded showing IS-0413 has been observed across several anteverse locations, including 2, 9, 15 and 33, indicating possible migration through what can only be described as 'bee-sized perforations'.

Compendium.Title: IS-0422
Compendium.Subtitle: Bogman
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Pending

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOLS: Containment protocols for these aggresive, semi-amphibious creatures are currently under review, but they are believed to have a sensivity to subsonic sound.

While not yet an official designation, IS-0422 was discovered by Dr. Lenora Riggs in Anteverse 168. 

The precise origins and evolution of IS-0422 are not yet understood, although Dr. Riggs theorizes that their presence in 168 may be connected to the Lodestone. If not endemic, their home anteverse is, at this stage, unknown.

Compendium.Title: IS-0513
Compendium.Subtitle: The Hate-Inducing Table
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (LC/PY)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: The effects of IS-0513 diminish rapidly with visual distance. As such, all personnel are directed to avoid looking directly at the subject except for specific or approved research purposes.

As evidenced by the asinine decoration of IS-0513 with amateur, even garish carvings, and the flagrantly tasteless choice of materials, this subject was clearly created by a talentless 'craftsman' with no natural aptitude for carpentry, resulting in arguably the world's single worst piece of furniture.

Compendium.Title: IS-0700
Compendium.Subtitle: The Presence
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Jura (IN/LC)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: All staff are prohibited from entering the area until further notice. No research permitted.

Compendium.Title: IS-0855
Compendium.Subtitle: The World in the Mirror
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Sanc (EX/GW/TL)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: All TR or research personnel visiting Anteverse 36 are required to: 

- Establish a locational beacon at the primary egress point. 

- Review position and confirm bearings every 200m if progressing further than 500m from the primary egress point.

- Establish satellite beacons every 2500m if proceeding further than 5000m in any direction.

Compendium.Title: IS-1057
Compendium.Subtitle: Yellow Paint
SectionTexts:
DESIGNATION: Jura (IN/LC)

CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL: Precise methods for containing IS-1057 remain unknown.
IS-1057 is thus far believed to appear randomly, although there is a statistically significant quantity of reports by people who were, at the time of sighting, lost or uncertain of their destination.

Compendium.Title: IS-1076
Compendium.Subtitle: The Core
SectionTexts:
The region in which A299-F appears embedded has been difficult to access. Study has therefore been largely theoretical, and the cause of its incursion from Anteverse 299 remains uncertain 

However, the so-called 'Core' appears to cause fluctuations in perforation activity, and observers have suggested that it may have grounded some of the undirected, trans-anteversal force following a recent destabillization event. Whether this is responsible for its translocation into the GATE Cascade Research Facility or not may never be known with absolute certainty.

The object appears old, but has also sustained damage, presumably in the process of transferring from A299 to A0, leaving it in what can only be described as a hibernational state. Precisely whether or not, or how it could be reactivated is unknown.

Compendium.Title: Warren Bunning
Compendium.Subtitle: Security Officer
SectionTexts:
Sydney-sider turned subterranean security specialist, Warren signed up expecting good pay and a fairly relaxed job.

The shift to Cascade hasn't gone quite as expected for this ex-Coogee mall cop.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Ulrich Thule
Compendium.Subtitle: Physicist
SectionTexts: Theoretical physicist, coffee aficionado, committed cynic, Dr. Thule has few friends among the GATE staff, but like many of his kind, is tolerated for his regular insights and occasional brilliance.

Compendium.Title: Grayson Isling
Compendium.Subtitle: Materials Engineer
SectionTexts:
Grayson's talent for cajoling metals and other materials to perform in new and unusual ways has made him an indispensable member of GATE's mechanical engineering team.

It is an eternal truth of the laboratory that those who create equipment and those who use it do not always see eye to eye, but Grayson is always focused on the job at hand, with very little interest in professional politics.

There may come a time, however, when politics will not be ignored.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Janet Ross
Compendium.Subtitle: Experimental Physicist
SectionTexts:
Experimental physicist specializing in exotic materials. Friend, collaborator and unofficial minder of Abe Stern.

Skeptic.

Dr. Ross has stated, on more than one occasion, her unwavering position that every event has a cause which can, under the correct conditions, be clearly documented. It is axiomatic that something cannot come from nothing. It follows that magic and the like are simply processes for which we do not yet fully grasp the causal links.

She also has expressed doubts about quantum uncertainty, suggesting that it says more about the limits of our perception, than the true boundaries of knowledge, let alone causation.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Abe Stern
Compendium.Subtitle: Molecular Physicist
SectionTexts: Genius, empiricist, creator of the Pocket Dimension, fan of Kizz Cola
While his involvement in IS-0173-B was not necessarily Dr. Stern's greatest contribution to human knowledge, it did garner him a much cherished pet: Ela.

Fundamentally, Dr. Stern is intrigued by new technology and its possibilities.

While he understands that unchecked sharing of information runs counter to the precepts of a private research facility like Cascade, his enthusiasm for the so-called 'Internet' was intense from the first DARPA proposals.

Shortly after receiving an invitation to test an early version of the 'World Wide Web' from his friend Tim Berners-Lee, he began experimenting with the system on his own private network. Certain that free and open access to knowledge is essential to human evolution, Dr. Stern now needs only to throw a switch to access the vast 'info-ocean'.

Compendium.Title: Alice Hong
Compendium.Subtitle: Defense Team
SectionTexts:
Alice Hong joined the GATE Defense Team at Rise Bio-Laboratory in 1988.

In 1990 she accepted secondment to the GATE Cascade Research Facility, where she manages research security and investigation into IS-0102, amongst other subjects.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Derek Manse
Compendium.Subtitle: Research Director
SectionTexts: Dr. Derek Manse became Director of Research at the GATE Cascade Research Facility, after his predecessor went on to become administrator of the GATE Latch Containment Facility in Tajikstan.

Compendium.Title: Marion
Compendium.Subtitle: Acolyte
SectionTexts: One of the few remaining denizens of Flathill, Marion worships the Composers like gods, convinced that they are harbingers of a greater fate.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Alice Mayfield
Compendium.Subtitle: Senior Data Scientist
SectionTexts: A protege of Martin Hellman at MIT, Dr. Mayfield went on to pursue a computer science doctorate. This in turn led to her becoming a minor star of the cryptographic theory and research field following her thesis on the stochastic isolation of random initialization vectors.

Compendium.Title: The Blacksmith
Compendium.Subtitle: F.O.R.G.E.
SectionTexts:
Fabrication expert, engineering genius and all-round mechanical mastermind, the Blacksmith is rumored to be able to perform parametric modeling in his head. The fact that he is never seen without full-body protective wear is now an accepted fact.

A subject of rampant speculation among the Manufacturing Sector team, no-one is entirely sure how he was recruited to GATE. This much is known: he was hired by Frake. Any more than that, she's not saying.

Dr. Jenik Veltman has secretly recorded the Blacksmith's speech, and observed that his vocal patterns are strikingly unique, even singular, matching no precise linguistic heritage he is aware of.

Compendium.Title: Hank Kettle
Compendium.Subtitle: Chemical Engineer
SectionTexts:
Regarded by many of those around him growing up as simple-minded, Hank Kettle never went to college. Instead he invented a new kind of friction-reducing paint out of sugar. It was enough to get Sarah Frake's attention, and shift him out of Ohio.

A single-minded savant with a deep-seated debt to Frake, the rest is history.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Katherine Pendleton
Compendium.Subtitle: Biologist
SectionTexts:
Expert on Anteverse 2, responsible more than any other researcher for GATE's growing understanding of that strange and exceptional realm.

Dr. Pendleton believes, but cannot yet conclusively prove, that there are secrets in Anteverse 2 - a force or even a consciousness that her team were on the brink of understanding ...

Compendium.Title: T.R. Enderson
Compendium.Subtitle: GATE Immurement Manager
SectionTexts: Responsible for overseeing and implementing containment processes and protocols across all GATE facilities, Enderson holds one of the organization's key positions.

The precise details of Enderson's career before GATE have provided material for widespread speculation by his colleagues, not to mention a fair share of graffiti in the bathroom stalls. Concrete information is few and far between. It is the opinion of this documentarian that further requests for background are to be discouraged to prevent cubicle visits from Enderson himself.

Hired directly by Annette Garrick in 1977, the fact he is the only member of the Executive Committee without a PhD speaks for her faith in his capabilities in other arenas.

Compendium.Title: Dr. A. Cahn
Compendium.Subtitle: Senior Researcher
SectionTexts: Renowned as curious.

Dr. Albert Cahn was the mind behind many of GATE's early successes.

Whether helping Dr. Stern isolate growth factors from Anteverse 42 entities, refining our understanding of IS-0017's behavior, or ejecting IS-0107 into interstellar space, Dr. Cahn's inquiring mind and incisive intellect earned him a respected position among the pure science staff at the GATE Cascade Research Facility.

He will always be with us.

- Dr. D. Manse

Compendium.Title: Dr. Annette Garrick
Compendium.Subtitle: GATE CEO
SectionTexts:
Founder and CEO of Garrick Advanced Technology Enterprises (est. 1967).

Responsible for overseeing the growth of a small applied research unit into a thriving international technology and research consortium, Garrick has been an unwavering source of focus and directives.

Precisely where she derives her priorities and sometimes astonishing insights remains a subject of speculation and near mythological awe among her employees and colleagues.

Compendium.Title: Sarah Frake
Compendium.Subtitle: Head Engineer
SectionTexts: GATE's Chief of Fabrication and Engineering Services.

Frake achieved her position in GATE by demonstrating two qualities: astonishing capability coupled with immense flexibility. At her best in situations where there are no rules, she is equally comfortable in the depths of a known but novel engineering problem, of which the GATE Cascade Research Facility abounds. 

She understands that the world can sometimes be reduced to a series of equations, but that it just as frequently refuses to submit to simple analysis.

Her genius - and her reputation for arriving at workable answers before anyone else - lies in recognizing that in both cases, there is usually only one path of action. Whether that means replacing a gasket or blowing up a particle accelerator, it's clear what needs to happen.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Hilda V. Dixon
Compendium.Subtitle: Field Researcher
SectionTexts: GATE TR Operator and Field Researcher.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Richard K. Moyer
Compendium.Subtitle: Office Sector Supervisor
SectionTexts: A bureaucrat who believes enlightenment is impossible in the absence of order.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Elanor Newman
Compendium.Subtitle: Particle Physicist
SectionTexts: Inventor of the Dark Lens, but she'd rather you didn't call it that.

Dr. Newman has been involved with perforation research since its inception, and is personally responsible for much of GATE's critical progress in this field.

Following the success of GATE's Flathill experiments, Dr. Newman spearheaded Cascade Facility's first on-site perforations in Reactor Sector in 1988. The location of these first portal systems close to the Hydroplant and the prototype Fusion reactor reflected the immense power demands of GATE's early systems.

Following Dr. Newman's invention of the Dark Lens and subsequent improvements in portal dynamics, these older systems were largely abandoned. They remain, in theory, functional in the depths of the Reactor Sector.

Compendium.Title: Celine Ahmed
Compendium.Subtitle: Defense Team
SectionTexts:
Focusing on off-site data protection and advanced privacy delivery, Celine Ahmed occupies a trusted position in the upper echelons of the GATE Defense Team.

She's near blind without her glasses, though.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Lenora Riggs
Compendium.Subtitle: TransRecon Operator
SectionTexts: Resourceful researcher and hardened survivor.

A legend among GATE staff, Dr. Lenora Rigg's explorations and exploits are legion. Among the most experienced TransRecon staff, Dr. Riggs is renowned for surviving the first encounters with monolithic Anteverse 42 entities, as well as discovering a countless array of new lifeforms, locations and living to tell the tale.

She literally wrote the survival handbook for field research, and many of her colleagues wonder how her experiences have failed to overwhelm her. For Riggs, the answer is simple, even if few understand it: There is a critical difference between shock and surprise.

Compendium.Title: Niketas
Compendium.Subtitle: Leader of Canaan
SectionTexts:
The leader and spiritual head of Canaan, Niketas is a power unto himself in the remote village.

Information on his life before Canaan is scarce, indicating possible erasure. How he gained possession of the artifact he calls 'the Lodestone', and how he used it to ignite his cult is unclear. He describes himself as a 'follower of Petrae', but betrays few clues as to who this 'messenger' - upon whom he bases his teachings - ultimately is or was.

The source or chemical makeup of the pyrotechnics used by the population is likewise uncertain, but there may be a correlation to the aforementioned artifact. He certainly uses these esoteric "talents" to sway the simple folk of Canaan, who revere him as a prophet and pilgrim frequently to his chapel to be granted the gift of this peculiar flame.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Moira Shepherd
Compendium.Subtitle: Data Scientist
SectionTexts: A data scientist who discovered the first indications of Order surveillance.

As one of Dr. Shepherd's closest colleagues, Dr. Mayfield, once said: 'Moira has spent too much of her life being right to bother saying 'I told you so' any more'. 

A woman renowned for her purpose and precision, she has voiced her doubts about Keystone's risk management on several previous occasions. No fan of the Gatekeepers, either, her work in data science has generally kept them at arm's length.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Ru Tang
Compendium.Subtitle: Exo-biologist
SectionTexts: A biologist with a knack for uncovering the strange and arcane properties of xeroflora. Secretly fond of video games.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Steven Stewart
Compendium.Subtitle: Particle Physicist
SectionTexts:
A militant realist, and distant relative of James Clerk Maxwell, or so he claims. 

Believes that something serious may have gone wrong in Labs Sector.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Suan Tengku
Compendium.Subtitle: Temporal Physicist
SectionTexts: Discoverer of a new, hyperluminal form of bosonic matter she hopes to name the 'Tengkuon'.

Dr. Suan Tengku is arguably the smartest person at the GATE Cascade Research Facility. Sometimes referred to as "the Woman Who Invented Time Travel", Dr. Tengku has revolutionized our understanding of the physical universe.

An over-achieving American scientist headhunted by GATE to spearhead their temporal research, one could almost suspect she traveled back in time to shape this future, because it's looking particularly bright for her.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Stewart Wakeman
Compendium.Subtitle: Software Engineer
SectionTexts: Robotics expert, software engineer and general information theorist.

Renowned for his wide-ranging intellect and extraordinary creativity, Dr. Stewart Wakeman has been given an almost unprecedented degree of research freedom at GATE Cascade Research Facility. His exact position in the chain of command, however, and who exactly approves his more exploratory investigations, is unclear to most staff.

Compendium.Title: Temporal Tethering
Compendium.Subtitle: Why do portal worlds reset?
SectionTexts:
"One of the most fascinating aspects of perforation technology is temporal tethering: Each entry to an anteverse seems to start a timer, which resets after a given period - as though a band of time stretches, before snapping back to its origin. I am confident we will understand this phenomenon in time, but until we do, it violates a dozen scientific principles."

~ Dr. Derek Manse

Compendium.Title: The Synchrotron
Compendium.Subtitle: The GATE Cascade Research Facility Collider
SectionTexts:
The GATE Cascade Research Facility's particle accelerator is one of the few private synchrotrons in the world. Operating at ranges approaching 1.0TeV, it is used in everything from materials research to trans-luminal investigations.

It was the synchroton that allowed Dr. S. Tengku to make her discovery of a new category of bosonic matter, opening the way for perforation technology.
In 1985, a condensation experiment accidentally created a small singularity that destroyed a section of Manufacturing and Labs. Luckily, only two people were killed.

Compendium.Title: The Dark Lens
Compendium.Subtitle: Tachyonic Telemetry Targeting (T3) Unit
SectionTexts:
The Dark Lens - technically a Tachyonic Telemetry Targeting or T3 unit - was developed by Elanor Newman to guide and control the tachyonic fields that underpin perforation technology.

It cannot safely be turned off.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Chris Jagger
Compendium.Subtitle: Alleged Employee
SectionTexts: While several GATE staff members claim to know and work with this person, very little tangible evidence of their existence currently exist.

Compendium.Title: Jonas Conti
Compendium.Subtitle: Defense Team
SectionTexts: A longstanding member of GATE's security force, Jonas is the only known survivor of the Defense Team unit dispatched by Rutger Strauss to secure the Hydroplant against the Order incursion.

Compendium.Title: Isaiah Deal
Compendium.Subtitle: Senior Hydroplant Manager
SectionTexts:
As a Senior Hydroplant Manager, no-one who knows the intricacies of sector more deeply than Isaiah. It is no exaggeration to say that the Cascade Facility's day-to-day operation rests on his shoulders.

Familiar with every inch of Cascade's power generation systems and requirements, he was injured by an Order Sagittari, but managed to take refuge in the Electrical Station.

Compendium.Title: Dr. David Hoff
Compendium.Subtitle: Generalist
SectionTexts:
Trained in biology, Dr. Hoff drifted into high-energy physics via the study of bio-quantum effects.

With a research bakground in everything from cognitive evolution to neutrino detection, he is one of GATE's true generalists. Like many of his ilk, he requires near constant oversight to ensure he is not distracted from his ostensible goals.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Siobhan Houston
Compendium.Subtitle: Materials Chemist
SectionTexts: A recent transfer from GATE Torii Facility who appears to be suffering a form of retrograde amnesia.

Compendium.Title: Dr. Hudson
Compendium.Subtitle: Astronomer
SectionTexts:
A new recruit to the Alpen Signal Observatorium, Dr. Hudson is the sole Astronomer currently working at the base.

Previously employed as an advisor to a Danish meteorology facility, Dr. Hudson replaced his predecessor roughly three months ago, at short notice. He knew little of the ASO, but saw the opportunity as a chance to advance his astronomical research career in relative peace and quiet.

Compendium.Title: STOLAS
Compendium.Subtitle: Institution
SectionTexts: A longstanding private organization with diverse commercial and scientific investments, including being parent company of the Alpen Signal Observatorium.

Compendium.Title: Kylie Muir
Compendium.Subtitle: Experimental Subject
SectionTexts:
Kylie Muir was recruited by Dr. Stewart Wakeman from [REDACTED] where she was being treated for lymphatic cancer. To escape death, she submitted to an experimental 'hosting' procedure, whereby her consciousness would be stored in digital format.

The procedure was interrupted by the Order invasion of the GATE Cascade Research Facility, and disappearance of Dr. Wakeman.

Although he refrained from revealing the precise details to Kylie Muir herself, Dr. Wakeman's intention was to create countless copies of her uploaded digital consciousness and install them in, amongst other things, a G.A.D.D. 'Defense' bot, in the hope of creating a self-aware weapons platform. Whether or not Kylie could be copied in such a manner remains unclear.

Compendium.Title: Fog Phenomenon
Compendium.Subtitle: Weather
SectionTexts:
Generally contained to Flathill and its surrounding area, the 'fog' phenomenon associated with Anteverse 1 occasionally leaks into the GATE Cascade Research Facility via open primary perforations.

While the fog phenomenon is a harmless water vapor with no known ill-effects on those exposed to it, GATE researchers believe it emanates directly from entities (e.g. IS-0064) and the atmospheres of all known locations in Anteverse 1.

Dr. Stern has theorized a hypothetical "mass micro-perforation event" could cause large influxes of this fog. Therefore, the fog's presence in the Facility, even briefly, may indicate a more significant containment concern.

As a precaution, GATE staff have installed a rapid ventilation override switch in Silo 3, which can help resolve a Fog Event sooner, though it's not entirely clear what the effect might be on the surface.

Compendium.Title: Radiation Leak
Compendium.Subtitle: Weather
SectionTexts:
Following the introduction of fusion reactor testing in the Plant sector of the Cascade Research Facility, GATE installed sensitive radiation detection apparatus, heavy duty air scrubbers and ventilation. Radiation 'events' are an ever-present health risk, but as long as the reactors remain stable, the danger remains low.

Recent revisions to the Gate Immurement Security Protocols (GISP) noted, however, that on-site perforation experiments will elevate this risk considerably if not carefully controlled.

As such, GISP stipulates Level 2 hazard-wear and frequent iodine supplements for all staff working in the vicinity of these reactors. Internal GATE researchers are also exploring other ingestible substances to mitigate radiation effects.

As a precaution, GATE technicians have installed a Rapid Ventilation switch in the Manufacturing West Shipping Control Tower, which may help clear the effects of a Radiation Leak Event. It is the GATE Safety Committee's understanding that this would have a negligible impact on surface wildlife over the next 10 years.

Compendium.Title: Airborne Spores
Compendium.Subtitle: Weather
SectionTexts:
As research expands across biological destinations throughout the so-called "Anteverses", all staff are reminded to take effective precautions when visiting these locations.

GISP-approved airtight maskings are required when conducting experiments or visiting any site with a risk of ingesting or inhaling spores, viral analogues or other contaminants that may cause respiratory issues, infection or death.

Returning to a GATE facility without undertaking complete decontamination procedures is strictly prohibited. Contamination of GATE property due to negligence by TransRecon or other field personnel is grounds for dismissal.

Compendium.Title: Rolling Blackouts
Compendium.Subtitle: Weather
SectionTexts:
The GATE Cascade Research Facility's power network is its most critical system, but far from invulnerable.
